We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM. Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law. If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com . To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form . Recruitment agencies TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

title: Demo Architect, EMEA
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As a Demo Architect, you'll help GitLab teams and customers get hands-on with our platform faster and with less friction. This role reports to the Senior Director of our Solutions Architecture Center of Excellence, with day-to-day partnership from the current team lead. You'll build and improve the tools, applications, and infrastructure that support field team demos, workshops, trials, and internal test environments across the field. What makes this role unique is its mix of software engineering, infrastructure, and customer-facing collaboration. You'll work like an engineer for much of the role, while also partnering with Solutions Architects, Account Executives, Customer Success, and others to make sure what we build is practical, usable, and aligned to how the field sells. What you'll do Build and maintain tools, applications, and workflows that support demos, workshops, trials, and internal test environments. Expand the Demo Architect Portal to improve automation, self-service, and scalability for field teams and partners. Provision and support infrastructure that enables hands-on customer experiences across GitLab.com , demo instances, and internal environments. Collaborate with Solutions Architects, Account Executives, Customer Success, Marketing, Revenue Operations, UX, and Engineering to understand needs and deliver practical technical solutions. Learn and document go-to-market workflows (e.g., how teams run demos/workshops/trials) and automate the steps that waste time. Create technical workshop assets and enablement content that support pre-sales and technical selling for individual contributors. Advise on sales opportunities when specialized technical demo support or custom solutions are needed. Improve the presenter experience by reducing manual setup work and making demo workflows easier to use and repeat. Support internal teams that rely on demo or test infrastructure, helping keep those environments available and useful. Troubleshoot urgent demo/workshop environment issues under pressure and communicate status clearly to stakeholders. What you'll bring Experience building software, systems, or internal tools that support technical users or business teams. Ability to deliver production-grade software and automation with attention to reliability, maintainability, and documentation. Ability to work across application development and infrastructure, with comfort navigating provisioning, automation, and service workflows. Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools to shorten investigation time when something breaks. Comfort communicating and collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Marketing, UX, and Engineering. Understanding of how to design and iterate on solutions for usability and repeatability, not just technical correctness, with awareness that the end user may be a seller or Solutions Architect. Ability to operate independently in a remote, asynchronous environment, with willingness to travel periodically for team offsites and occasional in-person planning/whiteboarding sessions. Exposure to technical demos, workshops, trials, or enablement assets, and/or interest in learning the pre-sales context; transferable experience from software engineering, site reliability engineering, systems engineering, solutions architecture, or similar technical paths. About the team On the Demo Architect team at GitLab, we support the field’s demo, workshop, and trial experiences by maintaining shared tooling and the infrastructure behind internal demo and test instances used across GitLab. We’re a small, globally distributed group that collaborates asynchronously across regions and adapts quickly to changing needs, with a current focus on scaling automation, enabling more self-service, extending support to partners, and maintaining reliable internal infrastructure. raw.jobDescription:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Demo Architect, you'll help GitLab teams and customers get hands-on with our platform faster and with less friction. This role reports to the Senior Director of our Solutions Architecture Center of Excellence, with day-to-day partnership from the current team lead. You'll build and improve the tools, applications, and infrastructure that support field team demos, workshops, trials, and internal test environments across the field.

What makes this role unique is its mix of software engineering, infrastructure, and customer-facing collaboration. You'll work like an engineer for much of the role, while also partnering with Solutions Architects, Account Executives, Customer Success, and others to make sure what we build is practical, usable, and aligned to how the field sells.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain tools, applications, and workflows that support demos, workshops, trials, and internal test environments.
  • Expand the Demo Architect Portal to improve automation, self-service, and scalability for field teams and partners.
  • Provision and support infrastructure that enables hands-on customer experiences across GitLab.com, demo instances, and internal environments.
  • Collaborate with Solutions Architects, Account Executives, Customer Success, Marketing, Revenue Operations, UX, and Engineering to understand needs and deliver practical technical solutions.
  • Learn and document go-to-market workflows (e.g., how teams run demos/workshops/trials) and automate the steps that waste time.
  • Create technical workshop assets and enablement content that support pre-sales and technical selling for individual contributors.
  • Advise on sales opportunities when specialized technical demo support or custom solutions are needed.
  • Improve the presenter experience by reducing manual setup work and making demo workflows easier to use and repeat.
  • Support internal teams that rely on demo or test infrastructure, helping keep those environments available and useful.
  • Troubleshoot urgent demo/workshop environment issues under pressure and communicate status clearly to stakeholders.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building software, systems, or internal tools that support technical users or business teams.
  • Ability to deliver production-grade software and automation with attention to reliability, maintainability, and documentation.
  • Ability to work across application development and infrastructure, with comfort navigating provisioning, automation, and service workflows.
  • Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools to shorten investigation time when something breaks.
  • Comfort communicating and collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Marketing, UX, and Engineering.
  • Understanding of how to design and iterate on solutions for usability and repeatability, not just technical correctness, with awareness that the end user may be a seller or Solutions Architect.
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, asynchronous environment, with willingness to travel periodically for team offsites and occasional in-person planning/whiteboarding sessions.
  • Exposure to technical demos, workshops, trials, or enablement assets, and/or interest in learning the pre-sales context; transferable experience from software engineering, site reliability engineering, systems engineering, solutions architecture, or similar technical paths.

About the team

On the Demo Architect team at GitLab, we support the field’s demo, workshop, and trial experiences by maintaining shared tooling and the infrastructure behind internal demo and test instances used across GitLab. We’re a small, globally distributed group that collaborates asynchronously across regions and adapts quickly to changing needs, with a current focus on scaling automation, enabling more self-service, extending support to partners, and maintaining reliable internal infrastructure.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

You care deeply about software quality and have experience with testing, code reviews, monitoring and mobile performance. About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

About the team

The Consumer Tribe builds the Alma app for consumers. To tackle more topics and accelerate the development of the consumer experience, the current Consumer squad is splitting into two dedicated squads: Alma Wallet and Consumer Engagement.

Alma Wallet builds the payment experience of the app. With the Alma card, consumers can pay with Alma anywhere, not only at our partner merchants. In the app, they can manage their payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay or local payment methods. By taking Alma beyond our merchant network, the Alma card is one of the company's key strategic bets.

Consumer Engagement drives consumer activation, engagement and long-term retention by helping people get more value from Alma. The team builds experiences that make it easier for consumers to discover partner merchants, benefit from loyalty and cashback rewards, and manage their account independently.

In 2027, the focus is on turning Alma into a more engaging, everyday consumer experience by strengthening loyalty, increasing repeat usage and making Consumer Engagement a key driver of Alma's long-term growth.

This is a new position created as the consumer app organization splits into two squads to tackle more topics. You will join one of these squads and work closely with its Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Designer and back-end engineers. You will report to Gautier Labarre, Engineering Manager.

This position is a permanent contract (CDI), open to full remote from Metropolitan France.

About the job

  • Build and ship meaningful consumer experiences: Develop and release new features in the Alma app from design to production, working closely with Product, Design and back-end engineers.
  • Make payments simple and secure: Integrate payment SDKs and native mobile capabilities such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, card management, biometrics and secure storage.
  • Raise the quality bar of the app: Keep the application fast, reliable and maintainable through automated testing, monitoring, code reviews and continuous performance improvements.
  • Help the team learn and move forward: Contribute to technical decisions, challenge product and back-end implementation when needed, and improve the team’s architecture, tooling and release processes.

You will work with

  • Mobile: Expo / EAS, Expo Router, React Native, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, react-hook-form, Zod, Reanimated, Unistyles, MMKV, Nitro modules.
  • Tests: Jest, Testing Library, Maestro.
  • Payments: Adyen, Stripe, Checkout.com SDKs.
  • Observability: Datadog, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, OpenFeature.
  • Back-end: Python, FastAPI.
  • Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma, Crowdin, Claude.

About you

To succeed in this job

  • You have 3+ years of experience building mobile applications with React Native and TypeScript, with experience releasing apps on both the App Store and Google Play.
  • You have a strong understanding of the React Native ecosystem, including Expo, navigation, state management and data fetching.
  • You care deeply about software quality and have experience with testing, code reviews, monitoring and mobile performance.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in a cross-functional, international environment.

And it will be nice if you also

  • Have worked on payment products, fintech products or other security-sensitive applications.
  • Have experience contributing to a consumer application used at scale.
  • Are comfortable challenging product or back-end implementation when it does not provide the best user or technical outcome.
  • Have experience with web development in addition to mobile development.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

What's in it for you

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

  • Work on products at the heart of Alma's strategy, including the Alma card, new payment methods in the app and our loyalty programme.
  • Solve real mobile fintech challenges involving payment SDKs, Apple Pay, Google Pay, biometrics and secure storage.
  • Use a modern mobile stack based on Expo 57, React Native’s New Architecture, React 19, TypeScript 7, Reanimated 4 and Nitro modules.

Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months
  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan
  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package
  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities
  • Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)
  • Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma
  • Mental health: free access to MindDay platform
  • Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)
  • Access to our Learning & Development Platform
  • 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

Interview Process

  • Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation and present you the role.
  • Video call with your future manager to deep dive into the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.
  • Live testing session with members of the Mobile Engineering team to assess your practical knowledge and approach to mobile development.
  • Coffee Chat with members of the squad you would join, with the panel adapted to Alma Wallet or Consumer Engagement.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Commodity Pricing Engine Developer to design, build, and enhance a bespoke pricing engine that generates real-time prices for client RFQ (Request for Quote) workflows. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in commodity derivatives pricing, quantitative model development, and software engineering, with a strong focus on delivering accurate and low-latency pricing solutions in trading environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain pricing models for commodity and OTC derivatives products.
  • Build, calibrate, and validate quantitative pricing models to ensure accuracy and robustness.
  • Develop and enhance a bespoke pricing engine for RFQ quote generation.
  • Integrate pricing models with market data feeds, trading platforms, and RFQ systems.
  • Optimize pricing calculations for real-time performance and low-latency execution.
  • Collaborate with traders, quants, and technology teams to translate business requirements into scalable solutions.
  • Conduct model testing, performance analysis, and continuous improvements.
  • Ensure compliance with model governance, validation standards, and risk management frameworks.
  • Support production deployments and troubleshoot pricing-related issues.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience in Commodity Derivatives or OTC Derivatives Pricing.
  • Proven expertise in Quantitative Development, including model creation, calibration, and validation.
  • Deep understanding of financial mathematics and derivatives valuation techniques.
  • Strong software engineering skills with proficiency in:
  • Python
  • C++
  • Java
  • Similar object-oriented programming languages
  • Experience integrating pricing systems with market data and trading platforms.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced trading environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building real-time pricing engines within electronic trading (e-Trading) environments.
  • Knowledge of Bloomberg market data integration.
  • Experience with messaging technologies and connectivity frameworks.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and high-performance computing concepts.
  • Understanding of commodity markets, trading workflows, and risk management processes.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

  • Foremost a software engineer. You exemplify high code quality and guide others, and have at least 5 years of industry experience as a data engineer or similar role.
    • You are experienced in creating automated testing, applying design patterns, and other engineering best practices.
    • You are an expert in Python and possess fluency in SQL and have developed maintainable data pipelines with each.

  • Product mindset. You think about the business impact of your work, and can use high-level goals to prioritize work.
  • Communication Extraordinaire. You excel at communicating to both technical and non-technical people, with an ability to explain complex concepts simply.

Here's How You Will Make an Impact

  • Collaborate with product managers, data analysts, and machine learning engineers to develop pipelines and ETL tasks in order to facilitate the extraction of insights.
  • Understand product requirements and translate them into actionable project plans that you or your peers execute upon.
  • Establish data architecture processes and practices that can be scheduled, automated, replicated and serve as standards for other teams to leverage.

  • Explore our stack
  • We have over 500 private repositories in Github containing our pipelines, our own internal multi-functional tools, and open-source projects
  • We have worked as a distributed team for a long time; we're currently about 65% distributed

  • Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

  • Flexible paid time off and company holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Professional development and learning opportunities
  • Wellness and mental health resources
  • Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)

  • Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.
  • Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.
  • Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.
  • Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.
  • Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

About NetDocuments At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge. Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls. Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms. That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including: Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies Five-time Top Workplace USA winner Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you. What You’ll Do NetDocuments is seeking a Staff Full Stack Software Engineer to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our next-generation document management systems. As a senior technical leader, you’ll drive the design, architecture, and delivery of scalable, event-driven platforms that power mission-critical frontend and backend solutions for our global customer base. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of backend architecture, cloud-native infrastructure, and full stack development—someone who builds production-ready applications at scale while guiding teams toward technical excellence. You’ll collaborate with product, design, and engineering leadership to define the direction of our systems and integrate cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven services and event-based data pipelines. If you’re passionate about building resilient systems, mentoring engineers, and driving innovation in how organizations manage and interact with their documents, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact. You will: Technical Leadership & Architecture Set technical direction for our document content extraction and transformation team, establishing patterns for scalable, secure, and performant systems on AWS. Lead architectural decisions that use OCR technologies such as Tesseract and Apryse OCR. Drive initiatives that improve scalability, performance, and reliability of the product while considering and implementing changes that control costs without impacting customer satisfaction. Guide the evolution of our content extraction and transformation technology stack as the business and customer needs mature and scale. Make critical technical decisions that balance user experience, performance, security, and maintainability. Product Design and Build Design and implement event-driven architectures using AWS services, Kafka, and modern data pipelines. Build production-grade applications across C#/.Net, AWS services, and document extraction/transformation technologies. Design and implement scalable APIs (REST, GraphQL) that power our front-end and enable third-party integrations. Integrate AI-driven services and emerging technologies to enable greater backend efficiencies and increase customer productivity. Build the product to enable seamless, scalable, and flexible semantic search capabilities. Ensure security, performance, and compliance considerations are applied across all implementations. Problem Solving & Ownership Solve complex technical challenges from real-time customer experiences and issues to event-driven document processing at scale. Take full ownership of initiatives from concept through production and ongoing evolution. Make sound architectural decisions by weighing trade-offs with reasoning that stands up over time. Proactively identify and address technical debt before it impacts the team. Build and Optimize Systems Write high-quality, well-tested code across the full stack with emphasis on maintainability. Design resilient systems that maintain uptime and performance as we scale globally. Implement observability through logging, metrics, and telemetry to proactively triage issues. Monitor and optimize performance at scale, identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions. Create comprehensive technical documentation including architectural diagrams and design decisions. Collaboration & Mentorship Partner closely with product management to translate requirements into technical solutions. Mentor engineers across experience levels, elevating technical skills and best practices. Collaborate with Platform Services, Ops, and other teams on integration points and shared infrastructure. Build consensus on technical approaches while having authority to make final decisions when needed. Lead knowledge-sharing initiatives through code reviews, design discussions, and documentation. Continuous Learning & Innovation Stay at the forefront of content extraction and transformation technologies and industry trends, cloud-native architectures, and AI-powered tools. Research and prove out new technologies through POCs that align with product strategy. Contribute ideas that directly improve engineering velocity and quality. What You’ll Need to Be Successful Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field—or equivalent experience. 8+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production-grade applications at scale on cloud platforms. 5+ years in technical leadership and development roles using OCR technologies. Proven track record of building scalable applications still in production. Required Technical Knowledge Expert proficiency in C#/.NET. Expert proficiency with OCR technologies such as Tesseract or Apryse Expert proficiency building event-driven, microservice-based products Expert proficiency developing on cloud platforms, preferably AWS Expert proficiency with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms Expert proficiency in observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, telemetry, preferably with DataDog What Will Make You Stand Out Deep experience building with OCR & Text Extraction technologies. Deep experience building document management or enterprise content management Deep knowledge of event-driven architectures. You know what it means and takes to ingest millions of documents an hour into a SaaS based document management platform Track record of developing high-performance content extraction and transformation products at scale. Legal industry expertise or experience with B2B SaaS in regulated industries. Experience integrating AI services and emerging technologies into production systems. What You’ll Love About NetDocuments The People! 90% healthcare premiums company covered HSA company contribution 401K match at 4% with immediate vesting Flexible PTO (typically 3 to 4 weeks a year) 10 paid holidays Monthly contributions for life activities & wellness Access to LinkedIn Learning with monthly dedicated time to explore Connection, access, and mentorship from exceptional leaders Growing company with opportunities for advancement Authenticity and accountability from leadership Compensation Transparency The compensation range for this position is $170,000 – $190,000. The posted cash compensation includes on-target earnings. Some roles may qualify for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. Equal Opportunity NetDocuments is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, (including pregnancy), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, military and veteran status, or any other status protected by laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. NetDocuments believes diversity and inclusion among our employees is critical to our success, and we are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

raw.jobDescription:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
  • Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

Description

Fleetio is looking for a product-minded and team-oriented Senior Software Engineer who is committed to consistently delivering quality software to join our rapidly scaling Marketplace Engineering Team.

Fleetio’s Marketplace is a comprehensive platform that facilitates our customers to easily find and purchase a wide range of products and services essential to their fleet operations. Our shop integrations allow our customers to efficiently manage external maintenance activities and get insight into service data. Our Maintenance Shop Network solution helps Fleet Managers to efficiently manage service work and provide simple, hassle-free ways to make payments. We also help vendors keep shop details current and monitor received payments from Fleetio customer transactions all in one place. Learn more about how our shop integrations work here.

In this role on the Marketplace Team you will be responsible for writing maintainable code while implementing new features with an emphasis on connecting customers to maintenance shops, facilitating service, approvals, transactions, billing, and data entry for fleets.

More About Our Team and Company

  • Watch our culture videos: https://fleet.io/culture
  • Engineering culture, interview process and videos: https://www.fleetio.com/careers/engineering
  • Fleetio Go overview video: https://www.fleetio.com/go
  • More about the Fleetio platform: https://www.fleetio.com/features
  • API docs: developer.fleetio.com
  • Test drive Fleetio to get an even better feel for what we're building: https://www.fleetio.com/register

This is a remote opportunity and is open to candidates in the United States, Canada, or Mexico.

Who You Are

Our ideal candidate has a passion for and experience collaborating with others and solving business problems with good design, delightful UX, and scalable architecture. You are detail-oriented, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where you can make a significant impact. You have extensive experience planning, designing, and building marketplace solutions with cross-functional partners such as Product Managers, Designers, and Quality Engineers. Your ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with others is key to your success. This role is part of the Engineering department, and you will report to the Web Engineering Manager.

Your Impact

  • You will take part in planning, designing, and implementing features to build out our Marketplace offering. Helping fleets and shops schedule, complete, and pay for service on the fleet's vehicles and equipment.
  • You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to consistently deliver high-quality software.
  • You will engage in collaborative design and architecture of features.
  • You will deliver well-tested, maintainable, and performant code.
  • You will research, implement prototypes, and spikes as necessary to validate assumptions and technical feasibility.
  • You will possess a strong voice in the development and planning processes.
  • You will thoroughly review your peers’ code to ensure quality, consistency, and to share knowledge.

Your Experience

  • 10+ years experience as a software engineer
  • 3+ years experience with Ruby on Rails
  • 2+ years experience with ReactJS, Typescript
  • Firm understanding of object-oriented programming and relational databases such as PostgreSQL
  • Expertise with consuming and integrating with external systems, APIs, and/or webhooks
  • Expertise with data modeling and optimizing query performance
  • Solid experience solving challenging architectural problems with good design
  • Experience with unit testing frameworks
  • Excellent communication skills (particularly written)
  • Be sure to mention “coffee” in your application so we know you actually read this

Considered a plus

  • Previous experience with Marketplace development
  • Experience leading small teams/projects
  • Previous experience building products that utilize LLMs to analyze user data
  • You know a thing or two about the Fleet management industry
  • Previous experience building APIs for consumer/mobile app consumption

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options
  • Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
  • Community service funds
  • Professional development funds
  • Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
  • Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
  • Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
  • Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote

This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will.

If you have a disability or a special need that requires an accommodation to fill out the online application, please let us know by calling (205) 718-7500.

title: Senior - Data Engineering (m/w/d) Azure und Databricks
description: Wir suchen Verstärkung für die Entwicklung, den Betrieb und die Optimierung moderner Datenplattformen. In dieser Position entwickelst du End-to-End-Datenlösungen mit Azure und Databricks und arbeitest eng mit Data Engineers, Analytics-Teams und Fachbereichen zusammen. Aufgaben Du entwickelst, betreibst und optimierst moderne Datenplattformen auf Azure und Databricks. Du konzipierst und implementierst skalierbare ETL- und ELT-Pipelines sowie Data-Lake- und Lakehouse-Architekturen. Du entwickelst bestehende Datenlösungen weiter und bindest Quellsysteme an. Du stellst Datenqualität, Performance und Stabilität sicher. Du arbeitest eng mit Analytics-, BI- und Fachbereichsteams zusammen. Du kennst dich mit Data-Lakehouse-Architekturen, ETL und ELT, Streaming sowie verteilter Datenverarbeitung aus. Du verfügst über Kenntnisse in Python, SQL, Apache Spark und Delta Lake sowie über Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code und CI/CD-Pipelines, beispielsweise mit Terraform. Our Global Structure

Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Elle est synonyme de forte croissance et d'immenses opportunités dans les années à venir. Nous opérons désormais dans 10 marchés à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes.

Nous gérons l'une des marketplaces tripartites les plus complexes du monde et nous le faisons en temps réel. Des millions de personnes clientes et des milliers de restaurants, de commerces en tous genres, de livreurs et de livreuses comptent sur nous pour être mis en relation en quelques secondes. Nos algorithmes sur lesquels repose cette marketplace sont l'ingrédient secret qui nous permettent de livrer nos commandes en un temps record.

Description de poste :

Vous serez ainsi en support des missions suivantes :

En tant que stagiaire Account Manager vous aiderez les Account Managers auxquels vous serez rattaché à développer leur portefeuille d'enseignes. Vos principales missions consisteront à : 

  • Assurer le suivi opérationnel et commercial des magasins de votre portefeuille.
  • Animer le portefeuille de magasins partenaires.
  • Analyser quotidiennement les performances opérationnelles des magasins.
  • Appeler quotidiennement les partenaires sous performants pour les accompagner dans leur excellence opérationnelle.
  • Assurer la bonne adoption des produits Deliveroo (application de réception des commandes, outils marketing, portail partenaire, etc.)
  • Paramétrer et mettre en place les campagnes marketing.

title: Chief of Staff (m/w/d)
description: ecopals entwickelt leistungsstarke Additive zur Modifikation von Asphalt und Bitumen. Unsere Produkte verbessern die technischen Eigenschaften von Asphalt und verbinden hohe Leistungsfähigkeit mit einem ressourcenschonenden Materialeinsatz. Das heutige Portfolio basiert auf leistungsfähigen Polymeren und wird kontinuierlich um weitere Additivkategorien erweitert. In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir unser Geschäft international aufgebaut und sind heute in mehr als zehn europäischen Märkten aktiv. Mit der nächsten Wachstumsphase steigen die Anforderungen an unsere Organisation. Insbesondere in den operativ anspruchsvollen Geschäftsbereichen müssen Strukturen und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt und aufeinander abgestimmt werden, um dieses Wachstum nachhaltig und effizient zu fördern. Als Chief of Staff (m/w/d) arbeitest du an dieser Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen. Du übersetzt strategische Ziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, koordinierst bereichsübergreifende Themen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen tragfähige Strukturen und funktionierende Abläufe entstehen. Dabei erhältst du Einblick in ein umfangreiches Spektrum geschäftsführungsnaher Themen und übernimmst eigenständig Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung. Aufgaben Organisationsentwicklung im Wachstum Du gestaltest und optimierst bereichsübergreifende Prozesse und sorgst dafür, dass operative Abläufe und strategische Unternehmensziele ineinandergreifen. Du erkennst Herausforderungen und Verbesserungspotenziale frühzeitig, entwickelst proaktiv Lösungsansätze und begleitest deren Umsetzung bis zur Verankerung im Arbeitsalltag. Du übersetzt die Prioritäten der Geschäftsführung in konkrete Maßnahmen, schaffst Transparenz über Fortschritte und Hindernisse wichtiger Workstreams und stellst sicher, dass Themen konsequent vorangetrieben werden. Dabei bist du in der Lage, zwischen Vogelperspektive und operativer Detailarbeit zu wechseln. Finance, Reporting und Investor Relations Du erstellst und verantwortest qualitative und quantitative Reportings für Gesellschafter. Dafür führst du Informationen aus verschiedenen Unternehmensbereichen zusammen, prüfst ihre Aussagekraft und bereitest sie adressatengerecht auf. Du bereitest die Kommunikation mit Investoren inhaltlich vor, koordinierst relevante Informationen und erstellst Unterlagen für Gespräche, Updates und weitere Termine. Du tauchst in die zugrunde liegenden Kennzahlen des Unternehmens ein und beteiligst dich aktiv an der Finanzplanung. Produktionsstrategie Du entwickelst mit externen Partnern die strategische Einkaufs- und Produktionsplanung weiter und stimmst Kapazitäten, Bedarfe und Beschaffungsentscheidungen auf die Unternehmensentwicklung ab. Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale entlang der Lieferkette und treibst Maßnahmen voran, die Wirtschaftlichkeit und operative Abläufe verbessern. Marktpositionierung und Außenauftritt Du entwickelst die Positionierung und den Außenauftritt von ecopals gemeinsam mit den relevanten Beteiligten weiter und sorgst für eine konsistente Kommunikation gegenüber Kunden, Partnern, Investoren und weiteren Stakeholdern. Du bereitest zentrale Unternehmensbotschaften und Kommunikationsinhalte auf und stellst sicher, dass unsere strategischen Prioritäten und Fortschritte klar und überzeugend vermittelt werden. Sparring für die Geschäftsführung und Sonderprojekte. Du bist ein inhaltlicher Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung, analysierst komplexe Fragestellungen, formulierst fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen und bringst auch alternative Perspektiven ein, wenn sie zu besseren Entscheidungen führen. Du steuerst mehrere Themen parallel und bewegst dich sicher zwischen analytischer Detailarbeit, der Abstimmung mit unterschiedlichen Beteiligten und der operativen Umsetzung. Du erkennst, welche Aufgaben du selbst vorantreiben solltest und wo du andere Teammitglieder sinnvoll einbindest. Dabei koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit und behältst Qualität, Fortschritt und Ergebnisse im Blick. Dein Profil Du bringst etwa drei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit, beispielsweise in Strategy & Operations eines Scale-ups, in der Unternehmensberatung oder in einer vergleichbaren generalistischen Inhouse-Funktion. Dabei hast du bereits komplexe Vorhaben eigenständig gesteuert und erfolgreich zum Abschluss gebracht. Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis, denkst unternehmerisch und kannst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge sicher beurteilen. Ein wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du strukturierst komplexe Fragestellungen, arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein und entwickelst auch bei unvollständiger Informationslage fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Du denkst voraus, erkennst Handlungsbedarf und Verbesserungspotenziale frühzeitig und entwickelst eigenständig Lösungsansätze, die du konsequent in die Umsetzung bringst. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse, arbeitest sorgfältig und legst hohe Qualitätsmaßstäbe an deine eigene Arbeit. Dabei behältst du das große Ganze im Blick und arbeitest dich bei Bedarf tief in operative Details ein. Du hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe konstruktiv, sprichst Probleme offen an und treibst Veränderungen mit Augenmaß und Nachdruck voran. Du arbeitest souverän mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammen, bringst verschiedene Perspektiven zusammen und treibst gemeinsame Vorhaben auch ohne direkte Weisungsbefugnis voran. Du kommunizierst klar und adressatengerecht und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen verständlich aufbereiten. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in PowerPoint und Excel. Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns sind analytische Stärke, unternehmerisches Denken, Eigeninitiative und die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, wichtiger als ein lückenlos passender Lebenslauf. Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, dazulernt und Themen eigenständig voranbringt. Unterschiedliche berufliche Hintergründe und Perspektiven sind ausdrücklich willkommen. Benefits Profitiere vom Unternehmenserfolg: Über unser Virtual Stock Option Program (VSOP) kannst du an der langfristigen Entwicklung von ecopals teilhaben. Verantwortung mit Gestaltungsspielraum: Du treibst eigene Themen von der Analyse bis zur Umsetzung voran und prägst die Weiterentwicklung von ecopals. Ein internationales Team mit Machermentalität: Du arbeitest mit einem motivierten, diversen Team, das unterschiedliche Perspektiven verbindet und gemeinsam anpackt. Startup-Spirit mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen: Transparente All-Hands, offene Feedbackkultur und schnelle Abstimmungen prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit. Modernes Office und flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Dich erwarten ein Büro nahe dem Berliner Ku’damm, Barista-Kaffee und Homeoffice nach Absprache. An Technologien mit echtem Impact arbeiten: Du hilfst dabei, den Straßenbau durch innovative Materiallösungen ressourcenschonender zu gestalten. title: Director of Pricing & Monetization
description: The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow. Meet Nuvei , the Canadian fintech company accelerating the business of clients around the world. Nuvei's modular, flexible and scalable technology allows leading companies to accept next-gen payments, offer all payout options and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 50 markets, 150 currencies and 700 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally with one integration. At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey! Your Mission We are looking for a Director of Pricing & Monetization , who will be responsible for defining and executing the company's pricing strategy to maximize revenue growth, profitability, and market competitiveness. This leader will develop scalable pricing frameworks, design bundled product offerings, lead willingness-to-pay research, and establish a data-driven approach to pricing across products, industries, customer segments, and geographies. The role sits at the intersection of Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Data Analytics & Product, ensuring pricing decisions balance customer value, competitive positioning, profitability, and growth objectives. Responsibilities Pricing Framework Development Design and maintain the company's enterprise-wide pricing framework. Develop attribute-based pricing models across products, industries, geographies, customer segments, and risk profiles. Establish pricing governance, policies, guardrails, and decision-making frameworks. Create methodologies for standard pricing, exception pricing, strategic discounts, and deal approvals. Define pricing architecture for new products and market launches. Bundling & Monetization Strategy Design and implement bundled product and service offerings that maximize customer value and company profitability. Identify opportunities to unbundle and re-bundle products to improve monetization and customer segmentation. Develop packaging strategies across core products, value-added services, premium features, and subscriptions. Partner with Product Management to create tiered "Good-Better-Best" pricing structures. Measure bundle performance and continuously optimize package economics. Willingness-to-Pay & Customer Research Lead willingness-to-pay studies and pricing research programs. Develop segmentation models based on customer value perception and purchasing behavior. Conduct customer interviews, surveys, conjoint analysis, Van Westendorp studies, and other pricing methodologies. Identify pricing drivers by industry, customer size, region, and product category. Translate customer insights into actionable pricing recommendations. Market & Competitive Intelligence Build and maintain a competitive pricing intelligence program. Monitor competitor pricing structures, packaging strategies, discounting practices, and market trends. Conduct benchmarking analyses to evaluate pricing position versus competitors. Identify emerging monetization strategies and disruptive pricing models. Provide executive recommendations on pricing actions required to maintain market competitiveness. Pricing Analytics & Optimization Develop pricing elasticity models and price-volume curves. Establish analytical frameworks to measure profitability, margin performance, and pricing effectiveness. Evaluate revenue impact of pricing changes before deployment. Track pricing KPIs and identify opportunities for revenue optimization. Support AI-driven and data-driven pricing initiatives. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Product, Finance, Commercial, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Data teams. Influence product roadmap decisions through monetization insights. Support executive leadership on strategic pricing investments and initiatives. Lead pricing councils, governance forums, and strategic pricing reviews. Manage and develop a high-performing pricing team. Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Pricing, Strategy, Product Management, Revenue Management, Consulting, or Commercial Excellence. 4+ years leading pricing strategy or monetization initiatives. Demonstrated experience building pricing frameworks and governance models. Strong background in market research and willingness-to-pay methodologies. Experience designing pricing bundles, packaging strategies, and commercial offers. Experience driving pricing transformations in complex organizations. Preferred Experience Payments, fintech, SaaS, software, technology, telecommunications, financial services, or marketplace experience. Experience with CPQ platforms, pricing systems, and revenue management tools. Knowledge of advanced pricing analytics, AI-driven pricing, and revenue optimization. Benefits Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can’t wait to meet you. Working Language English (written and spoken) is the language used most of the time, as work colleagues, clients, and strategic suppliers are geographically dispersed. ****Our recruitment process may use automated tools, including AI, to support application management and candidate shortlisting. The annual salary range for this role in the Netherlands is EUR 123,000 - EUR 130,000 (gross) . This range represents the expected starting salary for candidates hired into this role in the specified location. If the position is filled in a different location, a different salary range may apply due to objective factors such as local labor market conditions and cost of living. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Nuvei and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 50 markets, 150 currencies and 700 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally with one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service.   We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission 

We are looking for a Director of Pricing & Monetization, who will be responsible for defining and executing the company's pricing strategy to maximize revenue growth, profitability, and market competitiveness. This leader will develop scalable pricing frameworks, design bundled product offerings, lead willingness-to-pay research, and establish a data-driven approach to pricing across products, industries, customer segments, and geographies. The role sits at the intersection of Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Data Analytics & Product, ensuring pricing decisions balance customer value, competitive positioning, profitability, and growth objectives. 

Responsibilities 

Pricing Framework Development 

  • Design and maintain the company's enterprise-wide pricing framework. 
  • Develop attribute-based pricing models across products, industries, geographies, customer segments, and risk profiles. 
  • Establish pricing governance, policies, guardrails, and decision-making frameworks. 
  • Create methodologies for standard pricing, exception pricing, strategic discounts, and deal approvals. 
  • Define pricing architecture for new products and market launches. 

Bundling & Monetization Strategy 

  • Design and implement bundled product and service offerings that maximize customer value and company profitability. 
  • Identify opportunities to unbundle and re-bundle products to improve monetization and customer segmentation. 
  • Develop packaging strategies across core products, value-added services, premium features, and subscriptions. 
  • Partner with Product Management to create tiered "Good-Better-Best" pricing structures. 
  • Measure bundle performance and continuously optimize package economics. 

Willingness-to-Pay & Customer Research 

  • Lead willingness-to-pay studies and pricing research programs. 
  • Develop segmentation models based on customer value perception and purchasing behavior. 
  • Conduct customer interviews, surveys, conjoint analysis, Van Westendorp studies, and other pricing methodologies. 
  • Identify pricing drivers by industry, customer size, region, and product category. 
  • Translate customer insights into actionable pricing recommendations. 

Market & Competitive Intelligence 

  • Build and maintain a competitive pricing intelligence program. 
  • Monitor competitor pricing structures, packaging strategies, discounting practices, and market trends. 
  • Conduct benchmarking analyses to evaluate pricing position versus competitors. 
  • Identify emerging monetization strategies and disruptive pricing models. 
  • Provide executive recommendations on pricing actions required to maintain market competitiveness. 

Pricing Analytics & Optimization 

  • Develop pricing elasticity models and price-volume curves. 
  • Establish analytical frameworks to measure profitability, margin performance, and pricing effectiveness. 
  • Evaluate revenue impact of pricing changes before deployment. 
  • Track pricing KPIs and identify opportunities for revenue optimization. 
  • Support AI-driven and data-driven pricing initiatives. 

Cross-Functional Leadership 

  • Partner closely with Product, Finance, Commercial, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Data teams. 
  • Influence product roadmap decisions through monetization insights. 
  • Support executive leadership on strategic pricing investments and initiatives. 
  • Lead pricing councils, governance forums, and strategic pricing reviews. 
  • Manage and develop a high-performing pricing team. 

Qualifications 

  • 8+ years of experience in Pricing, Strategy, Product Management, Revenue Management, Consulting, or Commercial Excellence. 
  • 4+ years leading pricing strategy or monetization initiatives. 
  • Demonstrated experience building pricing frameworks and governance models. 
  • Strong background in market research and willingness-to-pay methodologies. 
  • Experience designing pricing bundles, packaging strategies, and commercial offers.

Preferred Experience

title: Director of Engineering, Frontend technologies, Marketplace Technologies
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

About the Role

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Frontend Technologies domain within Marketplace. In this role, your mission will be two-fold: 

  1. Pivot our frontend setup for bigger efficiency: we have been operating in mostly the same frontend setup for at least 6 years, and recognize that change is imminent.
  2. Drive strategic engineering initiatives: architect and implement platform-specific changes that enhance modularity, autonomy, resilience, and performance across Android, iOS, and Web. 

You will have to balance and prioritize foundational capabilities - such as Design Systems, CI/CD, Modularization, App Releases, Performance, and Global UI quality - to optimize both frontend developer velocity and user satisfaction.

You will lead 4 Engineering Managers and 3 Staff Engineers and set and implement the FE strategy, which will impact the roadmaps of 9 Product domains within the Marketplace.

In this position, you will

Strategically:

  • Ensure the most effective frontend setup for the Marketplace. We have 40+ teams, each with 3 frontend engineers (iOS, Android, and Web) in the Marketplace unit. We know this will look different in two years. Deciding what different means, and getting 9 product domains to fund it, is the job
  • Drive Technology Strategy: Set and drive the future technology strategy for frontends, establishing a modular, scalable architecture that enables rapid development and strategic growth. Basically - raise the technological bar for all Marketplace unit. 
  • Refine the domain's identity: Take sole ownership of shaping its future, successfully integrating Design Systems and engineering to treat our frontend platforms as a cohesive product.

Tactically: 

  • Lead frontends: Lead a horizontal, platform-focused domain containing Android, iOS, Web, and Design System teams.
  • Lead Initiatives: Oversee Marketplace-wide technical tooling, core libraries, and frameworks. Lead strategic projects, i.e., frontend modularization and modernization (SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose), native automated testing.
  • Elevate global UI quality: Integrate design systems and accessibility into the frontend ecosystem to consolidate technical, visual and interaction quality standards. Support UI experimentation.
  • Ensure Resilience & Reliability: Maintain robust release processes, Marketplace frontend quality, and performance monitoring to reduce downtime and ensure a consistent member experience.
  • Innovate & Optimize: Drive AI-efficiency enablement in frontend development and explore cross-platform frontend development opportunities to increase engineering speed and productivity.

A lot of this work will be influencing without formal authority: Champion the frontend technical vision among your director peers, influencing the leaders of 9 Product domains to accommodate and prioritize platform-wide changes across 40+ teams.

About you

How much of a technical acumen? Enough to have in depth conversations with our direct reports. You will have 4 strong technical EMs reporting to you, as well as 3 world-class staff engineers. We don’t think you need to match their technical competencies (that’s a stretch!), but you have to be able to speak their language, understand problems at their essence, and be able to consolidate and multiply their inputs, including being able to disagree objectively.

Leadership: you have a track record of making level change in the organizations that you lead (rather than 20% change). Consolidating your team views and making coherent strategy out of those views is step one. Step two is even more important: being able to implement these changes in your domain, and more so - across other domains in the marketplace - is a foundational ability you carry. In practice, that means you have at least 2 years of experience leading leaders and 5 years of experience influencing without authority. 

Change horizon: You are comfortable holding two timeframes at once. We need someone who can say, "Here is what our frontend setup should look like in two years, and here is why" AND name the clear deliverable that has to ship in the first quarter to make that end state reachable. Leaders who only do the second are common. Leaders who only do the first are entertaining. We need both.

What this role is not: This is not a hands-on frontend or release-engineering role. You will not be tuning CI, owning the release train, or reviewing architecture decisions yourself — you’ll have 4 strong EMs and 3 Staff Engineers close to the details, and your job is to turn their technical judgment into direction, alignment, and organizational change. If your strongest work is deep in the mechanics, you'll be underused here. If your strongest work is changing how 40+ teams operate, you'll be busy.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • A daily lunch allowance
  • ClassPass (Gym Membership subsidy)
  • Pension plan with total contribution of 12%, 8% by the Company and 4% by employee
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • An NS mobility card
  • The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work 

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

 

The annual gross salary range for this position is:
€108.600—€147.000 EUR

title: Senior Backend Engineer, VGo Carrier Technology
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
