Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Senior Backend Engineer in the Vinted Go Carrier domain, you will build backend systems that move parcels through Vinted Go's own logistics network, between hubs and through warehouses, quickly, reliably and at scale.

You'll join Vinted Go, the logistics arm of Vinted, focused on making shipping more affordable, convenient, and reliable. Your team, Pacman, owns mid-mile logistics and warehouse operations automation: how parcels are routed and transported between hubs, and how they are received, labelled, and dispatched.

We're looking for a strong engineer who also makes the engineers around them better: someone who leads the team's hardest technical problems and actively shares what they know, so the whole team grows with them.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs that power mid-mile transport and warehouse operations.
  • Own technical initiatives end to end, from problem framing and system design through delivery, monitoring, and iteration, and lead projects that span the team or the wider domain.
  • Make architecture and trade-off decisions with a 6–12 month horizon, balancing scalability, reliability, maintainability, and tech debt.
  • Help evolve our core service, a large Ruby on Rails modular monolith, towards clearer module boundaries and well-defined APIs.
  • Collaborate with Product, Operations, Decision Science, and neighboring engineering teams to shape discovery, sequencing, and implementation, and align on contracts and dependencies through RFCs and technical discussions.
  • Actively share knowledge: give thoughtful code reviews, pair on hard problems, walk the team through complex changes, and keep documentation useful.
  • Help onboard new team members, mentor engineers informally, and trust others with meaningful work while supporting them to succeed.
  • Work with a backend stack that includes Ruby, Vitess, Kafka, Jenkins, Elastic, and observability tools; you do not need to know all of it upfront.
  • Take ownership of service reliability, alerts, metrics, SLOs, and incident follow-up, including participation in on-call rotations.
  • Take part in hiring by interviewing candidates and helping raise the bar.
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your development workflow and help the team move faster.

About you 

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of building systems and owning work from design through production.
  • Solid experience with Ruby, or the ability and motivation to learn Vinted's backend stack quickly.
  • Good understanding of API design, database-backed systems, observability, and operating services in production.
  • Works independently on problems of diverse scope, and is someone teammates turn to for advice on difficult technical matters.
  • Pragmatic problem solver who balances delivery speed, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and breaking complex product or operational problems into clear technical steps.
  • Genuinely enjoys sharing knowledge and mentoring others, and sees raising the team's engineering standards as part of the job.
  • Gives direct, useful feedback, seeks it in return, and builds alignment across teams.
  • Collaborative and clear communicator who works well with engineers, product managers, operations, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Advantage: experience with logistics, warehouse management, fulfillment, or operational workflows; integrating software with physical devices; or modularizing a large monolith.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 working days of holiday
  • Access to all the tools & tech needed for work
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Private health insurance
  • Pension plan with flexible contribution options and a matching contribution from Vinted
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • A dog-friendly office
  • In Vilnius office: Gym & in-house meals at friendly prices
  • In Kaunas office: a monthly lunch allowance, and a once-a-week provided in-house lunch and breakfast

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:
€76.800—€104.000 EUR

title: Senior Software Engineer (Elite Motorsport)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Motorsport)

DO YOU WANT TO WORK FOR THE WORLD LEADER IN ELITE SPORTS PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS?

Catapult is a world leader in sports performance technology, serving over 5000 teams across 40 sports. We improve many of your favorite athletes' performances with our wearable tracking technology, video and data analysis systems, and athlete management products. Our technology offers objective solutions to sport-based challenges and can be found throughout the NFL, NHL, NBA, AFL, NRL, Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga and many more.

In Motorsport, Catapult’s SBG race management and team strategy systems are the technology of choice for elite-level organisers and competitors around the world, including in Formula 1, Formula E, IndyCar, NASCAR, WEC/Le Mans and other worldwide endurance racing. Customers include the FIA (in F1, F2, F3, F1 Academy, FE and WEC), nine Formula 1 teams (including the 8-time World Champion Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team), the majority of Formula E teams, the winners of multiple Le Mans 24-hour races over the last 10 years (Audi, Porsche, and Toyota) and teams and organisers in both IndyCar and NASCAR. 

We have major offices in the UK (London and Leeds), USA (Boston) and Australia (Melbourne) as well as multiple smaller offices around the world.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SPORTS AND WANT TO WIN

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Senior Software Engineer (Motorsport) to grow our Motorsport development team as we expand our RaceWatch products into new series and tackle new challenges.

Based in London, you will be a key player in developing new capabilities in RaceWatch, particularly for Endurance racing strategy, but also contributing to the entire RaceWatch suite across different racing series.

We believe that our customers deserve the best platform, and we are on a mission to maximise and enhance their performance through delivering the highest quality experience. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help us drive our products and processes forward, as well as acting as a mentor and providing technical leadership to other team members. You will be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series.
  • Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks.
  • Identify ways to add innovative new features to the software.
  • Lead others to anticipate and meet customer needs.
  • Be one of the technical leaders within the team.
  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
  • Ensure code quality, organization, and best practices throughout the development process.
  • Lead with a growth mindset, encouraging others to share ideas and opinions.
  • Maintain and enhance software reliability.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • A passion for Motorsport.
  • 5+ years working in a fast-paced, technical environment, delivering software to customers.
  • A proven track record of building applications in C/C++.
  • Experience developing products, scaling them, and supporting them throughout the entire lifecycle.
  • An aptitude for working with complex data.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, both internally and when speaking to customers.
  • A willingness to go above and beyond for the customer.

title: Senior Tensor AI Scientist
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Scientist to join our Advanced Computing & Modelling team and take a leading role in our research at the intersection of tensor networks and modern machine learning. This is an area of strategic importance for Terra Quantum, with applications across several industries.

Your mission is to help grow and strengthen this research and to apply it to demanding real-world problems. We are looking for someone with a broad background in AI and machine learning and strong mathematical foundations, so they can either bring relevant expertise in this area or pick it up and start contributing quickly.

The role reports to the Director of Advanced Technologies and works closely with scientists and engineers across the division.

 

Responsibilities

  • Take a leading role in advancing and scaling up our tensor network research, developing new methods for efficient ML model architectures, training, and optimisation, and pushing them beyond the current state of the art.
  • Design and train modern deep learning models, with a focus on making large-scale training more efficient.
  • Develop and improve the algorithms at the core of our methods, taking ideas from concept to validated result.
  • Work with teams across the division to apply these methods to challenging real-world
  • Contribute to patents and selected publications, and represent Terra Quantum at leading conferences.
  • Help structure the team's research and mentor junior colleagues, raising both scientific and engineering standards.
  • Collaborate with engineers across the division to run methods efficiently on modern computing platforms.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • Must have more than 5 years of relevant post-PhD experience (or equivalent experience after an MSc) with significant relevant experience in machine learning, applied mathematics, computer science, or a closely related field, with strong mathematical foundations in linear algebra, numerical methods, optimisation, and probability.
  • Hands-on experience training modern deep learning models such as transformers, including efficient large-scale training and fine-tuning, using frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.
  • Strong command of optimisation methods for machine learning, including gradient-based and large-scale optimisation, regularisation, and training dynamics and
  • Experience with efficient training and model compression techniques, such as low-rank methods, quantisation, distillation, or sparsity.
  • A demonstrated ability to master new mathematical frameworks quickly: either existing expertise in this area, or a clear track record showing you can pick it up
  • Strong Python skills and solid software-engineering practice, with experience on GPU and HPC environments and distributed training.
  • A record of publications or patents, and the ability to take a research direction from concept to result independently.
  • Strong communication and organisational skills, and the willingness to guide and develop junior colleagues.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of tensor networks and related numerical and optimisation
  • Domain exposure to one or more of: finance, chemistry, or operations
  • Knowledge of C++ and familiarity with quantum computing

 

The Rewards 

We are an international team of quantum technology experts and dedicated business creatives that are working to bring quantum-enabled solutions to the global market. Our brilliant team members enjoy a high degree of freedom working remotely or joining one of our office spaces. We have a vibrant, enthusiastic, passionate and creative culture driven by trust, excellence and continuous improvement. If you join the Terra Quantum team, you can expect: 

  • An opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the pioneering field of Quantum Technologies as well as an experienced and progressive Leadership team
  • Gain knowledge of some of the most cutting-edge technology developments in science & engineering 
  • A chance to be part of one of Europe’s leading technology firms of the upcoming decades
  • Welcoming, friendly, and professional colleagues
  • A personal development plan with clear goals for advancement
  • A competitive salary 
  • Flexible working arrangements 
  • A diverse and supportive atmosphere, where innovation and initiative are encouraged  

If you are enthusiastic about positively impacting the world and helping to drive the second quantum revolution, let’s talk! 

 

Company description 

Quantum technologies have the potential to solve some of the world’s biggest challenges. There have been great advances in all areas of quantum technologies, and new fields of application are opened up every day. Hybrid computer systems that combine classic high-performance computing with quantum computers are already being used to develop solutions in sectors such as logistics, healthcare, finance, energy, automotive and aerospace. Quantum mechanical predictions are also used to obtain unprecedented precision in measurements, generate unbreakable codes, and form the basis of impenetrable communication networks. All these developments are happening right now, and they are happening at Terra Quantum. 

At Terra Quantum we are building the world’s leading Quantum Technology company. We offer customers world-class quantum technology expertise organized as “quantum-as-a-service”: hybrid quantum algorithms, quantum compute and quantum enabled security solutions. Through the proprietary quantum cloud, customers have access to a unique technology platform which provides a toolset to solve real-world challenges in the realms of machine learning, optimization and simulation, today. In 2022, the company closed its Series A financing round with a $75m fundraise. 

Quantum physics has, in some respects, parallels to the machine language of our computers-the zeros and ones into which our keyboard or touchscreen instructions are translated for execution in the computer-only on a larger scale: it is the machine language of the universe. The second quantum revolution is based on the control of individual quantum systems, such as individual atoms. We use quantum computers to solve currently unsolvable problems, simulate molecules and their interactions, find drugs for diseases that are not yet curable, find new materials, or make artificial intelligence stronger. Quantum is now. 

Terra Quantum is a future-focused quantum services and technology company working on making the second quantum revolution a reality. Terra Quantum’s activities span all areas, markets, and industries globally. 

  • Our purpose is to pioneer quantum technologies to change the world for good,
  • Our vision is to lead the quantum revolution and be the trailblazer in technology solutions, shaping a better future for humankind to thrive in, and
  • Our mission is to unleash the power of quantum tech to deliver meaningful solutions today

Terra Quantum is an equal opportunities employer, committed to diversity, inclusion and employee well-being.

title: Quality Systems Lead
description: About us Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator. The role We're hiring a Quality Systems Lead to own how Encord measures the quality of the human data we deliver to frontier AI labs, physical AI companies and enterprise AI teams — the standard itself, the systems that evaluate against it, and the audit function that produces the ground truth behind both. Data quality is what our customers buy. As we scale across data types — image and video, document, medical, LLM evaluation, robot teleoperation, egocentric capture — quality coverage cannot scale linearly with headcount. So this role has two halves that make each other work. You will build automated evaluation: model-assisted and LLM-based screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output. And you will build and run a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists in India, whose judgements become the labelled ground truth that trains and calibrates that automated layer. As coverage automates, the audit team moves up to the cases models can't judge and to generating gold sets for each new data type we take on. It is an unusual combination — engineering and consistent QC operations in one person — and it is the combination the job needs. You will also have an advantage your counterparts elsewhere in the industry don't: Encord owns the platform this work runs on, so the measurement you build can become native capability in the product rather than internal tooling. What you'll do Build automated dataset quality evaluation and root-cause detection — model-assisted and LLM-as-judge screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output Hire, train, calibrate and manage a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists based in our India operation, held to inter-rater agreement and catch rate rather than volume audited Turn audit output into labelled ground truth that trains and validates the automated layer, and manage the ratio of automated to manual coverage deliberately over time Own the quality standard for every data type we deliver — written rubrics with worked edge cases, golden sets, and acceptance criteria agreed with the customer, alongside the Special Projects lead, before the first batch ships Build scoring systems that rank annotator and reviewer performance and feed routing, staffing and offboarding decisions Set the pass thresholds that certification gates on, so nobody works a project queue without having demonstrated they meet the standard Report quality KPIs to leadership, and into the reporting our Special Projects leads take to customers: accuracy against client spec, inter-annotator agreement, rework rate, cost of rework, and coverage Work with Project Management on remediation — you produce the measurement and the diagnosis, production owns fixing the project, and the standard stays independent of the people being measured Own the unit economics of quality: cost per audited unit, and the coverage you buy per pound spent Partner with Product and Engineering to bring quality measurement into Encord platform as native capability Who we're looking for You build and you operate. You'll write the evaluation pipeline, and you'll also run the weekly calibration session with ten auditors in another country Your instinct on a coverage problem is to automate it — you reach for a model, a heuristic or a better sampling design before you reach for more auditors Statistically literate in a practical way: sampling design, agreement statistics, and the judgement to spot a metric being optimised against rather than met You can hold a calibrated standard across a distributed team you don't sit with — you know that ten uncalibrated auditors produce ten standards A strong writer. Much of this job is producing rubrics a distributed workforce can follow without you in the room You hold a standard under commercial pressure, and you bring the evidence that makes it stick with a delivery team or a client Systems thinker: as interested in why a failure recurs across projects as in this project's defect rate Experience requirements 4+ years owning both technical and operational outcomes in a data, AI or service delivery environment where quality was measured rather than asserted Hands-on Python and SQL. You build the analysis and the tooling rather than specify it for someone else Practical experience applying models to a quality or evaluation problem — LLM-as-judge, model-assisted QA, automated evaluation, anomaly detection or classifier-based screening Sampling methodology and agreement statistics (Cohen's and Fleiss' kappa, F1 against ground truth) applied to real production data Experience hiring, training and managing a team, ideally an audit, review or QA team, and ideally distributed Track record of building a quality framework or function, including the reporting leadership and customers run on Bonus: direct experience of annotation, evaluation or model-training workflows, and of what frontier AI labs accept as evidence of quality Bonus: a STEM degree, or a background in data science or research engineering Bonus: multilingual delivery and linguistic quality assessment Why Encord Competitive salary, commission, and equity in a high-growth startup Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays Annual learning & development budget Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe Company lunches twice a week Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Own the quality standard for every data type we deliver — written rubrics with worked edge cases, golden sets, and acceptance criteria agreed with the customer, alongside the Special Projects lead, before the first batch ships

  • Report quality KPIs to leadership, and into the reporting our Special Projects leads take to customers: accuracy against client spec, inter-annotator agreement, rework rate, cost of rework, and coverage

  • Work with Project Management on remediation — you produce the measurement and the diagnosis, production owns fixing the project, and the standard stays independent of the people being measured

  • Own the unit economics of quality: cost per audited unit, and the coverage you buy per pound spent

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to bring quality measurement into Encord platform as native capability

Who we're looking for

  • You build and you operate. You'll write the evaluation pipeline, and you'll also run the weekly calibration session with ten auditors in another country

  • Your instinct on a coverage problem is to automate it — you reach for a model, a heuristic or a better sampling design before you reach for more auditors

  • You can hold a calibrated standard across a distributed team you don't sit with — you know that ten uncalibrated auditors produce ten standards

  • A strong writer. Much of this job is producing rubrics a distributed workforce can follow without you in the room

Experience requirements

Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.


What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.


With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity.

About the role

LemFi is expanding fast, and Pakistan is one of the most important diaspora corridors we are building for. This role sits at the centre of that ambition. You will own growth outcomes end to end for your market, acting as both strategist and hands-on operator, embedded in the community we serve, travelling across the UK to show up where it matters, and pulling every lever from grassroots events to data-led campaign optimisation.

You will work closely with Growth, Marketing, Product, and Operations, and you will be the loudest internal voice for the user. If LemFi's product, messaging, or positioning is not landing with your communities, you will be the first to know and the first to fix it. This is a role for someone who owns outcomes, not activities, and who finds energy in ambiguity rather than being slowed down by it.

What you'll build and own

  • Own user acquisition targets for Pakistan end to end - online and offline - and be accountable for the numbers, not just the effort.

  • Build and execute acquisition strategies tailored to the Pakistani community, using data and insight to optimise against KPIs and cut what is not working fast.

  • Lead community-driven initiatives - events, meetups, forums - that build genuine trust and advocacy for LemFi, not just brand awareness for its own sake.

  • Identify, negotiate, and manage partnerships with organisations and businesses that move the needle on user growth, ensuring every partnership delivers measurable value.

  • Conduct ongoing market research to understand what your users actually need, and turn those insights into clear, actionable recommendations for Product and Marketing.

  • Serve as the internal voice of the user - represent community perspectives in decisions about features, messaging, and positioning, and push back when LemFi gets it wrong.

  • Use AI tools to streamline research, content, and reporting so more of your time goes to high-impact work in the field and less to admin.

Your experience

  • Proven track record in growth, sales, or marketing in a fast-paced environment, with clear evidence of hitting ambitious targets.

  • Strong analytical skills - you read data, spot what it is telling you, and adjust your approach without waiting to be asked.

  • Strong cultural awareness and understanding of the Pakistani diaspora community in the UK, with the ability to build authentic trust with diverse stakeholders.

  • Demonstrable experience leading community engagement, including events, partnerships, grassroots activations, with a track record of delivering tangible outcomes

  • Established relationships and networks within Pakistani diaspora organisations, community groups and stakeholder networks in the UK

  • Excellent communicator who can influence partners, community leaders, and internal teams with equal confidence.

  • Self-directed and comfortable operating with ambiguity - you do not need a detailed playbook to make progress.

  • Willing to travel regularly across the UK, including occasional weekends, to represent LemFi where our communities are.

Nice to have

  • Experience working in or with remittance, fintech, or financial services products.

  • Proficiency in Urdu, Punjabi, or another language commonly spoken within the Pakistani diaspora community in the UK.


Why Join LemFi?

Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this.

At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions.

You can connect with us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.

Recruitment Agencies Notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners. Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting). Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively. Own vulnerability management end to end: a risk-ranked backlog, remediation SLAs, an escalation path, and closing findings together with the teams. Kennis van archiefwetgeving en recordmanagement: het beheren van documenten en informatie. Inzicht in het verbeteren van processen en dienstverlening. Het vermogen om resultaten te beoordelen en verbeteringen door te voeren. Interesse in technologische ontwikkelingen en hun invloed op het werk. Damit steigen die Anforderungen an Prozessklarheit, Datenqualität und fachliche Tiefe in der Buchhaltung. Deshalb suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit in Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche), die in der laufenden Buchhaltung selbst mit anpackt, die Buchhaltung im ERP-Projekt fachlich vertritt und unsere Prozesse Schritt für Schritt weiterentwickelt. Wir messen Erfolg an sauberen, termingerechten Abschlüssen für beide Gesellschaften, an verwertbaren Ergebnissen im ERP-Projekt und an Prozessen, die nach der Einführung einfacher und sicherer laufen als heute. Hands-on vor Ort: Du unterstützt unsere Umsetzung in den Gebäuden, installierst Sensorik sowie weitere Hardware und grenzt Fehlerquellen an technischen Anlagen systematisch ein. Modellierung: Du modellierst Standorte als digitalen Zwilling und schaffst so die Datengrundlage für unsere Optimierungen. Datenanalyse: Mit unseren digitalen Tools untersuchst Du Standorte nach Fehlern oder Anomalien und arbeitest Ursachen heraus. Tech-Setup: Du provisionierst Edge-Computer, konfigurierst Hardware und unterstützt unser Team im operativen Projektgeschäft. Prozess-Gestaltung: Du arbeitest aktiv daran mit, unsere Projektabläufe noch effizienter zu machen und sie zu leben. Das bringst Du mit: Studium: Du studierst Energie-und Gebäudetechnik, Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, Mechatronik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang (mind. noch 2 Semester). Mindset: Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und hast keine Angst davor, auch mal selbst zum Schraubendreher zu greifen. Auftreten: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und trittst unseren Kunden gegenüber professionell und freundlich auf. Pluspunkte (optional): Eine abgeschlossene handwerkliche Ausbildung (z. B. Elektriker, Mechatroniker). Erweiterte Kenntnisse in der Hands-On-Programmierung. Vorerfahrung im Bereich TGA (Technische Gebäudeausrüstung). Das sind Deine Vorteile bei uns: Eigenverantwortung: Kleines dynamisches Team, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege. Zentrale Lage & Arbeitsmodell: Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell. Unser zentral gelegenes Büro ist gut erreichbar und bietet Raum für Austausch und Zusammenarbeit. Steile Lernkurve: Du lernst hands-on, wie Projekte in einem modernen Start-up funktionieren, im direkten Austausch mit unserem CEO und dem Tech-Team. Sinnstiftend: Du arbeitest direkt an der Bekämpfung des Klimawandels – Dein Impact ist messbar. Feiertags-Bonus: Heiligabend und Silvester sind bei uns arbeitsfrei.   • Thrives in a high-growth environment where priorities evolve regularly and decisions are made quickly

  • Experience with Material Design, ideally Material 3

  • Experience with GoLang, Swift, and Java

Senior Database Engineer (Oracle/PostgreSQL), 80–100 % Werde Teil eines erfahrenen Teams, das gemeinsam eine moderne, skalierbare Datenbank- und Infrastrukturplattform gestaltet und betreibt. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung, gestaltest Architektur‑Entscheide und bringst eigene Ideen ein. Du arbeitest an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenbank- und Data-Warehouse-Plattformen, bei der Migration von Oracle nach PostgreSQL und beim Ausbau unserer Datenbankplattformen in der Azure Cloud. Dich erwartet ein starkes Team: 3 weitere DBAs und 8 Linux Engineers arbeiten mit engem technischem Austausch und kurzen Entscheidungswegen zusammen. Wir sprechen CH-Mundart & Deutsch und sind mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche im Büro Luzern. Du arbeitest in einem selbstorganisierten Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Flexibilität, Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb und Engineering von Oracle oder PostgreSQL Datenbanken. Begeisterung für moderne Plattform- und Cloud-Technologien. Erfahrung in der Automatisierung (z. B. Bash, Python, Ansible) und Freude daran, Dinge nachhaltig zu verbessern. Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, schnelle Auffassungsgabe und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch. Analytisches Denken, konzeptionelle Stärke und eine lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise. Informatikausbildung oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Firmensprache) sowie die Fähigkeit, englische Dokumentationen sicher zu verstehen. Nice to have / Dein Entwicklungspotenzial Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD und deklarativen Systemen. Automatisierung mit Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Actions oder Chef. Infrastruktur-Provisionierung mit Terraform (On-Prem & Azure). Arbeitszeit: Du hast eine 41-Stunden-Woche und kannst Teilzeit oder flexibel arbeiten. Für ausgewählte Tätigkeiten kannst du regelmässig von zu Hause aus arbeiten. Familienfreundlich: Voller Lohn während 14 Mutterschaftswochen. Zusatzbeiträge zu Kinder- und Ausbildungszulagen. Bis zu 90 % Kostenübernahme für die Fremdbetreuung deiner Kinder. Aus- und Weiterbildung: Die CONCORDIA unterstützt interne und externe Weiterbildungen. About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Overview:

As an Engineering Manager at Fanatics, you will be a technical leader with the ability to grow and scale engineering teams that can deliver business results and ship high-quality software for customer-facing products and internal platforms.

We own the Fanatics App, the mobile app at Fanatics that encompasses elements from all of our different brands and businesses. The Fanatics App brings together Free to Play games, live events, ecommerce, and new product experiences to deliver a best-in-class Sports platform. Fundamentally, we are one team in everything we do, from the user experience to coding and architecture. We aim to deliver on our Customer Promise by delighting our millions of monthly active users.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide leadership and technical expertise within your engineering vertical
  • Build and lead one or more teams that will deliver software while adhering (and contributing) to engineering best practices
  • Clarify technical requirements, negotiate priorities, and manage projects to deliver on time by leading daily scrum activities
  • Clears or escalates blockers to accelerate progress of delivery
  • Work closely with your product and design partners to create an ambitious, yet achievable roadmap that can be communicated to executives and stakeholders
  • Drive reliable and predictable team execution by setting clear objectives, using data and KPIs to drive transparency, and champion continuous improvement across engineering practices and systems
  • Provide clear updates (KPIs, status, metrics) to an executive audience and key stakeholders
  • Determine where to simplify, optimize, or extend solutions for the best outcomes
  • Help to recruit, assess and onboard a diverse group of talented engineers
  • Must be open to occasional travel to Fanatics offices and other locations for conferences, events, meetings, and team-building activities

Required Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of experience managing an engineering team
  • 4+ years of experience building highly scalable and fault tolerant systems
  • You have knowledge of a broad range of design approaches and can deconstruct an architecture to be developed by different teams
  • Able to scope a project and with targeted dates to ensure they meet business needs
  • Knows how to discern which features are essential, can be triaged, or omitted and works to negotiate with Product Management
  • Able to effectively communicate complex technical subjects to a variety of audiences (engineers, technical leaders, marketing and operations teams, non-technical functional leaders)
  • Familiar with Agile software product delivery and SCRUM methodology
  • Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
  • Solid report writing skills with the ability to gather, evaluate and analyze relevant information while structuring material in a logical and coherent manner.
  • Thrives in an entrepreneurial, hyper-growth environment where priorities evolve regularly and decisions are made quickly
  • Team-first mentality, with a willingness to do what it takes to get the job done and a desire to strive for better
  • Able to effectively work cross-functionally within an enterprise environment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in a start-up environment
  • Strong mobile software engineering background
  • Experience working with Kotlin Multiplatform and/or Compose Multiplatform

If you possess some of these qualifications but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!

#LI-AC2

raw.description:
About Tangible

Tangible Markets builds secondary market infrastructure for private fund LP interests. Our platforms help investors, wealth managers, fund managers and lenders buy, sell, price, finance and close secondary transactions. Our products:

Liquidity Hub: a secondary marketplace where LPs list fund interests and qualified buyers bid, with liquidity windows, tender offers and NAV lending.

Auctions: a competitive sale process for fund interests, supported by pricing models, pricing reports and market sentiment data.

Closing Platform: a transaction workflow built with a leading law firm to manage transfer documents, signatures and closing steps.

The role

You own the design of our products end to end, from research to shipped UI. You work with product, engineering and data teams on complex financial workflows used by institutional buyers, wealth advisors, lenders, fund managers and lawyers. Several products run as white-label versions for large financial partners.

Position open to candidates based in the EU and the UK.

Responsibilities

  • Own visual branding and design direction across every product, with a modern and consistent standard.

  • Lead the UX and UI revamp across the whole platform.

  • Design end-to-end flows across all products: onboarding, listings, bidding, pricing, financing and closing.

  • Turn complex financial and legal processes into clear, simple interfaces.

  • Design data-dense screens: pricing outputs, dashboards, reports, tables and comparisons.

  • Run user research and usability testing with buyers, sellers, advisors and partners.

  • Own the design system across products and white-label client versions.

  • Own the design process, including where AI tools fit to speed up research, prototyping and production.

  • Own design organization: files, handoff, and how work moves from design to build.

  • Set the quality bar and hold it. Nothing ships that has not cleared it.

  • Direct the product designer and review their output.

  • Work with engineering through build and QA so designs ship as intended.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of product design experience, including 3+ years on complex B2B, fintech or enterprise products.

  • Deep UX skills: information architecture, interaction design, user research and usability testing.

  • Proven experience building and maintaining a design system in Figma: components, tokens, variants and documentation.

  • Daily use of AI productivity tools in design work (for example Claude, Figma AI, v0 or Cursor) to prototype and iterate fast.

  • Experience designing multi-step, multi-role workflows with permissions, statuses and approvals.

  • Experience with multi-tenant or white-label products.

  • Working knowledge of front-end basics (HTML, CSS, component libraries) and how designs translate to code.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain design decisions to business and tech teams.

  • A portfolio showing process, trade-offs and shipped work.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of private markets, secondaries, wealth management or capital markets.

  • Experience in regulated industries: compliance flows, audit trails, disclosures and e-signature.

  • Accessibility knowledge (WCAG).

Please submit your resume, portfolio, and a brief cover letter explaining your experience and why you want to join Tangible. Portfolios are reviewed before interviews are scheduled, so make sure yours is up to date.

title: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines - 60%
description: À propos de FPP Industries FPP Industries poursuit son développement et souhaite aujourd’hui structurer davantage sa fonction Ressources Humaines. Dans ce contexte, nous créons un poste de Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines à 60 % , directement rattaché à la Direction générale. L’enjeu : construire une gestion RH à la fois fiable, structurée et humaine, capable d’accompagner durablement le développement de l’entreprise. Pourquoi ce poste existe Jusqu’à présent, les différents sujets RH ont été pris en charge sans fonction RH dédiée. Avec le développement de l’entreprise, nous souhaitons désormais franchir une nouvelle étape : fiabiliser l’administration du personnel, structurer nos pratiques RH et offrir aux collaborateurs comme aux managers un interlocuteur clairement identifié. Il s’agit donc d’une création de poste . Vous rejoindrez une fonction qui a déjà un cadre et des responsabilités définis, mais dans laquelle de nombreux processus restent à structurer et à faire évoluer. Votre mission Votre mission sera de structurer, administrer et faire vivre les Ressources Humaines de FPP Industries , en garantissant une gestion fiable du quotidien tout en construisant progressivement les pratiques RH dont l’entreprise aura besoin pour poursuivre son développement. Vous serez le référent RH opérationnel de l’entreprise et travaillerez en lien direct avec la Direction, les managers, les collaborateurs ainsi que les partenaires externes. Vos responsabilités principales Garantir une administration RH et une paie fiables. Vous prenez en charge le suivi administratif des collaborateurs, de leur arrivée à leur départ : contrats et avenants, absences, congés, périodes d’essai, visites médicales, échéances et dossiers individuels. Vous collectez et contrôlez les variables de paie, établissez les bulletins de salaire et sécurisez leur remise dans les délais. Piloter les recrutements et les intégrations. Vous accompagnez les managers dans la définition de leurs besoins, rédigez et diffusez les offres, présélectionnez les candidatures, réalisez les premiers entretiens et coordonnez le processus jusqu’à l’intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs. Développer les compétences. Vous identifiez les besoins avec les managers, organisez et suivez les formations et contribuez progressivement à construire une vision claire des compétences disponibles et à développer dans l’entreprise. Accompagner les managers et les collaborateurs. Vous devenez un interlocuteur RH accessible au quotidien. Vous accompagnez les managers dans leurs problématiques humaines, organisez les campagnes d’entretiens et contribuez à identifier suffisamment tôt les situations nécessitant une attention particulière. Structurer et améliorer les pratiques RH. Vous fiabilisez les données, construisez les indicateurs utiles au pilotage, formalisez les processus et proposez des améliorations concrètes pour simplifier le fonctionnement RH et l’expérience collaborateur. Accompagner la mise en conformité liée au développement de l’entreprise. Vous contribuerez notamment aux chantiers liés au CSE, au DUERP et à la structuration progressive de la démarche RSE, en lien avec la Direction et l’évolution de l’entreprise. Ce que nous attendons de vous Indispensable Vous disposez de bases solides en administration du personnel et droit social français . Vous êtes capable de prendre en charge la production des bulletins de salaire , tout en sachant solliciter un prestataire ou un conseil externe lorsqu’une situation nécessite une expertise technique ou réglementaire particulière. Vous savez conduire un recrutement, accompagner une intégration et travailler avec des managers sur leurs problématiques RH quotidiennes. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils bureautiques et suffisamment structuré(e) pour tenir des données, documents et échéances RH avec un haut niveau de fiabilité. La confidentialité, la rigueur et la fiabilité sont pour vous non négociables. Votre manière de travailler Ce poste conviendra particulièrement à une personne qui apprécie autant faire fonctionner le quotidien que construire ce qui n’existe pas encore . Vous aimez comprendre avant d’agir, structurer, documenter et améliorer. Vous êtes capable d’avancer de manière autonome dans votre périmètre tout en sachant identifier les décisions qui nécessitent un arbitrage de la Direction. Vous savez écouter sans perdre votre neutralité, accompagner sans vous substituer au manager et challenger avec tact lorsqu’une situation le nécessite. Vous êtes également à l’aise dans un environnement où la fonction RH continuera à évoluer avec le développement de l’entreprise. Ce que nous vous offrons Vous rejoignez FPP Industries au moment où la fonction RH se structure réellement. Vous ne reprendrez donc pas simplement un poste existant : vous aurez l’opportunité de contribuer directement à la construction et à l’amélioration de nos pratiques RH . Le poste offre un lien direct avec la Direction, une réelle autonomie dans l’organisation du quotidien RH et un périmètre susceptible d’évoluer progressivement avec le développement de l’entreprise et du groupe. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne souhaitant construire une fonction utile, pragmatique et proche du terrain. Informations pratiques Lieu : Le Cannet, France Taux d’activité : 60 % Contrat : CDI Contexte : création de poste Rattachement : Direction générale Management direct : aucun dans un premier temps Entrée souhaitée : 1er janvier 2027 Processus de recrutement Notre objectif est de prendre le temps de vérifier l’adéquation réciproque entre votre manière de travailler, la réalité du poste et le fonctionnement de FPP Industries. Les différentes étapes du processus et leurs délais vous seront présentés clairement dès les premiers échanges. Envie de construire cette fonction avec nous ? Si vous aimez les Ressources Humaines à la fois pour leur exigence administrative, leur dimension humaine et leur rôle dans la structuration d’une entreprise , nous serons heureux de découvrir votre candidature. Postulez et expliquez-nous ce qui vous donne envie de rejoindre FPP Industries et de participer à la construction de cette fonction RH. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Freelance Back End / Typescript Developer
description:
At Schuberg Philis, we build mission-critical IT solutions that power some of the most essential operations of our clients. Reliability, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. We are looking for a Senior Freelance TypeScript Software Engineer who enjoys designing and building resilient, high-performance systems that have a direct impact on large-scale operational processes.

As part of our team, you will help shape the future of critical digital infrastructures, working on complex challenges where software quality, scalability, and reliability truly matter.

We are looking for a Senior Freelance Software Engineer with an open mind and a genuine passion for software architecture. Together with our customers, we solve a wide range of challenges, from creating more user-friendly online banking platforms and designing business-critical portals and backend systems, to making industrial environments smarter through the combination of cloud technologies and IoT.

For this specific project, you will work closely with developers and architects to design and build software that connects operator- and customer-facing hardware with a large-scale backend platform supporting parcel logistics operations across an international network of hubs. The platform powers critical parcel handling processes throughout Europe and beyond, serving as a key component in the global logistics chain.

The platform enables parcel intake, sorting, routing, and grouping processes across distribution hubs. It actively interacts with parcels in real time, processing events generated by scanners, handheld devices, and automated sorting systems. Every parcel moving through the network is represented and tracked by the platform, making it one of the most visible and operationally critical systems within the organization.

For this assignment, we are specifically looking for freelance professionals. We offer an initial 6-month contract with the possibility of extension, providing the opportunity to contribute to the continued evolution of a mission-critical platform operating at international scale.

Our ideal colleague brings:

  • 5-7+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong experience designing and building microservices and event-driven architectures in cloud environments
  • Proven experience developing backend solutions with TypeScript and Node.js
  • Hands-on experience building serverless applications on AWS, particularly with services such as AWS Lambda and DynamoDB
  • The ability to write high-quality, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code
  • Experience working with large-scale distributed systems processing high volumes of real-time operational events
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions, and modern cloud-native development practices
  • Experience integrating services and APIs within complex enterprise environments
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work closely with engineers and architects to design reliable and scalable solutions
  • A security-first mindset; practical security experience is a plus

Everyone we work with, and everyone we consider working with, has the right to equal treatment. Our hiring process is designed to be thorough, objective, and fair, ensuring equal opportunities, compensation, and growth for all candidates and colleagues.

We believe great teams are built through diversity of thought, background, experience, and perspective. We actively encourage applications from people of different nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and backgrounds, and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which everyone can thrive.

Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics. 
 
It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers how agents are created, shared and connected to tools inside and outside GitLab, how they run, and how their work shows up and can be observed across GitLab.

In this role you'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Who We Are Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too. We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s computer vision AI open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more . Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors. Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We’re curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment. What You’ll Do We’re hiring Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to be the first technical hands on our new customer’s Roboflow deployments. After our Sales and Solutions Architecture team closes a deal and validates the technical approach, you step in to take it from proof-of-concept to production, the critical 0-to-1 phase where vision meets reality. You’ll embed directly with new Customers, working alongside their engineering and operations teams to build and deploy their first production computer vision workflows on Roboflow. This is the most difficult, important and rewarding phase of the customer journey. Infrastructure is unfamiliar, data pipelines need to be built, edge devices need to be configured, and models need to perform in real-world conditions, not just in a demo or a lab. The FDE role is more than just execution, you are also our eyes and ears in the field. You'll see the gap between what a Customer thinks they want, and what they actually need. That insight is invaluable, and you'll feed it directly back to our Product and Engineering teams, shaping the Roboflow platform and solution offerings. The best FDEs don't just deploy solutions; they surface the problems worth solving next. Once you’ve proven the deployment works in production and the customer’s team is equipped to operate it, you hand off to our Implementation Engineers who scale, optimize, and expand the solution across additional use cases. You’re the tip of the spear, the person who makes the first deployment work, no matter what it takes; the adventurer, the explorer, the builder. Five years from now, FDE at Roboflow on a resume should mean what a few years at Palantir or a FAANG company means. That's the bar we're hiring against. Role and Responsibilities 0-to-1 Deployment: Take validated proof-of-concepts from the pre-sales process and build the first production deployment. This includes data pipeline setup, model optimization, edge device configuration, and integration with customer infrastructure. Edge-First Engineering: Deploy and operate computer vision systems on edge hardware in physical environments. Where conditions are unpredictable and connectivity is unreliable. This is hands-on, hardware-heavy work. Embed with Customers: Work on-site or deeply embedded with the customer’s engineering team during the initial deployment phase (typically 4–12 weeks per engagement). Build trust, transfer knowledge, and establish the foundation for long-term success. Production Engineering: Write production-grade code that will live in the customer’s environment. Handle the messy realities of real-world computer vision: lighting variability, camera calibration, model drift, network latency, and edge hardware constraints. Be Our Eyes and Ears in the Field: You'll be closer to the customer's real problems than anyone else at Roboflow. You'll surface the gap between what the customer says they want, what they actually need, and what the machine operators on the floor think. That feedback loop back to Product and Engineering shapes what we build next, and it's one of the most valuable things FDEs bring back to the company. Knowledge Transfer & Handoff: Document your deployment architecture, create runbooks, and train the customer’s team so they can operate the system independently. Provide a clean handoff to Roboflow’s Implementation Engineers for scaling and expansion. De-risk New Deployments: Identify and resolve technical risks early. If a customer’s environment won’t support the planned architecture, you find the alternative before it becomes a project failure. Shape the Deployment Playbook: Codify repeatable deployment patterns, starter templates, and reusable artifacts that make future deployments faster and more reliable. The Skillset You’ll Bring Meaningful experience deploying technology in physical-world environments. We value breadth, working across different industries, hardware platforms, and deployment contexts, over depth at a single company. The best FDEs we've hired have built things in factories, warehouses, construction sites, or labs before ever touching a vision model. Strong proficiency in Python; experience with systems-level work (Docker, Kubernetes, networking, Linux) is highly valued. Hands-on experience deploying machine learning or computer vision models to production; you understand the gap between a working notebook and a reliable pipeline. Experience with edge computing hardware and constraints (NVIDIA Jetson, industrial cameras, limited connectivity, on-premise security requirements). Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills; you’re the person who figures out why it works in staging but not in production. Strong interpersonal skills - you'll be embedded with customer teams and need to build trust quickly while navigating their internal dynamics. You'll talk to executives, engineers, and machine operators, sometimes in the same meeting. Experience in one or more of Roboflow’s target verticals: manufacturing, logistics, food processing, automotive, or retail. Willingness to travel ~40–50% for on-site customer deployments. Preferred Attributes Experience in a professional services, deployment engineering, or forward deployed engineering role. Familiarity with CV/MLOps tooling and practices (model versioning, monitoring, retraining pipelines). Deep industrial subject matter expertise. The kind of person who can walk onto a production line and immediately start asking the right questions about throughput, defect rates, and inspection points. Background in IoT, embedded systems, or infrastructure engineering alongside hands-on deployment experience. You're a tinkerer outside of work. You own a 3D printer, you've got Raspberry Pis running something in your house, you're constantly tweaking your home network or smart home setup. You enjoy figuring out why something doesn't work as much as you enjoy building it in the first place. Who You’ll Be Working With Our team of ~120 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll be partnering directly with our co-founder/CEO and Sales leadership to not only do great work in the role, but shape how this function works for the future of Roboflow. Where You’ll Work Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and São Paulo (with plans to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you’d like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best! When You’ll Work Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week. Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed. What You’ll Receive To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market. The target base compensation for this role is $180,000–$250,000, with additional equity compensation. Compensation and scope of ownership will be determined based on demonstrated capability, expected impact, and the needs of the business. Target OTE: $ In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits: $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space $350/mo AI Tools $150/mo Team lunch $500/one time Home office Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision Interview Process (~5 hours) Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We like to be decisive and work fast, so don’t be surprised if all the below conversations happen over a few days. Before the Interview: We’ll review your application, LinkedIn, Github, etc. The best way to stand out is to write about something you’ve built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects. We may send you a technical screen if applicable. Introduction Phase: [45m] Meet with hiring manager to assess for overall mindset and skillset Team Interview Phase: [60m] Technical Assessment - live coding or architecture session [30m] Demo - build a project with Roboflow and share your work Final Interview Stage: [30m] Meet with Head of Operations, for a culture discussion [30m] Meet with Joseph Nelson, CEO Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can. Not Sure If This Is You? We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role or subscribe to our career newsletter by emailing “Subscribe” to operations@roboflow.com. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time. Roboflow is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds, communities, and experiences. title: Senior Consumer Duty Specialist
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role In this role, you will play a central part in assessing, questioning, and enhancing how customers experience Pleo. Drawing on deep regulatory knowledge, you will lead Consumer Duty initiatives, actively spot potential customer harm, examine what drives customer journeys, and ensure targeted remediation creates lasting, positive impact. You'll need sharp analytical skills and the confidence to influence stakeholders, translating data and MI into decisive action. You will construct and manage dashboards and reporting mechanisms that illuminate emerging patterns, vulnerable customer risks, and key concerns, offering executive leadership clear visibility into operational gaps and necessary solutions. Your contribution goes well beyond producing MI. You will conduct QA across complex complaint handling and sensitive customer interactions, manage Ombudsman cases, and speak up when evidence shows outcomes aren't meeting expectations. Collaborating across teams, you'll turn data-driven insights into practical improvements, drive projects to completion, and evaluate whether changes deliver real results for our users. We're seeking someone who views Consumer Duty as a powerful driver of business improvement rather than a routine compliance exercise. You'll bring together technical understanding, rigorous analysis, and constructive challenge to investigate root causes, align key partners, deliver change, and prove that customer experiences are continuously getting better. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You'll work closely with teams across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, Technology, and other business functions. The role will have broad exposure across the organisation, particularly when customer outcome risks or Consumer Duty-related remediation require cross-functional action. You'll also work closely with senior stakeholders through Consumer Duty governance and reporting, helping translate detailed analysis into clear insights, risks, recommendations, and actions. What you’ll be doing As a Consumer Duty Specialist, you will: Turn data into customer outcome insight : Build and own MI, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting that give the business a clear view of customer outcomes, trends, risks, and emerging areas of concern. Own Consumer Duty reporting : Produce monthly and quarterly Consumer Duty reporting, turning complex data into a clear story for senior leadership and Board-level audiences. You'll go beyond showing what happened to explain why it matters and what we should do about it . Identify customer harm : Use complaints, QA findings, customer feedback, vulnerable customer data, Ombudsman cases, and MI to identify potential customer harm, emerging risks, and systemic issues. Challenge the business : Where the evidence suggests customers aren't receiving good outcomes, you'll be expected to ask difficult questions, challenge assumptions, and ensure the issue is properly understood and addressed. Drive remediation and change : Work with stakeholders across the business to agree remediation plans, establish clear owners and timelines, and help drive Consumer Duty-related projects and improvements through to completion. Provide complaints QA : Conduct weekly quality reviews of complaints handled by the Complaints Manager, using findings to identify quality issues, customer risks, and wider trends. Manage Ombudsman activity : Act as the primary operational contact with the UK Ombudsman, managing referred complaints, responses, remedies, compensation, invoices, and related communications. Leverage AI and smart automation : Spot opportunities to apply automated tools and AI to scale and streamline Consumer Duty analytics, monitoring, and workflows. You will feel empowered to test emerging tech and eliminate repetitive manual work, maintaining proper critical evaluation and human governance whenever compliance risks or customer impacts are involved. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: Strong Consumer Duty knowledge : You understand the principles of Consumer Duty and how they translate into practical customer outcomes, particularly across complaints, customer support, vulnerable customers, and customer journeys. Strong data and MI experience : You know how to take complex data, build meaningful dashboards and reporting, and identify the insights that actually matter. You're comfortable working with data rather than simply consuming reports created by others. A customer outcome mindset : You're naturally curious about how customers are experiencing the business and are able to connect data, customer feedback, complaints, and operational activity to real customer outcomes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills : You can spot trends, anomalies, and patterns, investigate root causes, and determine whether an issue is isolated or potentially systemic. The confidence to challenge : You're comfortable questioning decisions, processes, and assumptions when the evidence suggests customers may be experiencing poor outcomes. You can challenge constructively and build relationships at the same time. A bias towards action : You don't believe reporting is the end of the process. You want to understand what needs to change, bring people together, and help make it happen. Project and remediation experience : You're comfortable managing actions, timelines, dependencies, stakeholders, and risks across cross-functional projects, particularly where there is a regulatory, customer, or operational outcome to deliver. An AI and automation mindset : You're naturally curious about how AI and automation can make processes more efficient, improve analysis, and free up time for higher-value work. You look for sensible opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and use AI to augment your thinking, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, critical judgement, and accountability — particularly where customer outcomes or regulatory decisions are involved. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You love using data to uncover things that others might not see. You want your analysis to drive real change, rather than sit in a report or dashboard. You enjoy asking "why?" and getting to the root cause of customer problems. You're comfortable challenging the business when the evidence tells you something isn't working. This role is not a good fit for you if: You prefer to produce reporting without being involved in what happens afterwards. You're uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or having difficult conversations when customer outcomes aren't where they should be. You prefer working within a narrow functional remit rather than across multiple teams. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll: Build a deep understanding of our customer outcome data, existing Consumer Duty MI, complaints, vulnerable customer journeys, and current areas of risk. Take ownership of key Consumer Duty dashboards and reporting, developing a clear view of the metrics and insights that matter most. Establish strong relationships with stakeholders across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, and Technology. Lead the analysis behind Consumer Duty reporting and help shape how customer outcomes are presented to senior stakeholders and the Board. Over time, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Pleo measures, understands, and improves customer outcomes, helping move Consumer Duty from a regulatory obligation into a genuine driver of better customer experiences and better business decisions. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Meet the Hiring Manager: 1hr going through role in more depth. Pleo Challenge: A case study were you talk us through how you'd solve a work appropriate challenge. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we advertised this role, we received a really high volume of applications but could only select so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
