raw.title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

title: Stage - Data Engineer - ML (H/F)
description: Chez Withings, nous développons des appareils de santé connectée : nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs. Notre objectif est de permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de sa santé. Au sein de l'équipe Machine Learning, nous développons des algorithmes pour extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales pour nos utilisateurs tels que le SPO2, la fréquence cardiaque, la présence de diverses pathologies comme la fibrillation atriale, l'apnée du sommeil… Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire motivé.e par des sujets de santé avec des compétences en traitement du signal, en machine learning et en deep learning pour nous aider à concevoir les algorithmes de demain. Votre mission L'objectif de ce stage est de concevoir, développer et valider des algorithmes capables d'extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales fiables à partir des signaux physiques collectés par nos dispositifs. Pour mener à bien cette mission passionnante, la/le stagiaire aura l'opportunité de : Explorer et analyser des ensembles de données physiologiques réelles issues de nos utilisateurs, à la recherche de marqueurs pertinents. Concevoir et développer des algorithmes combinant des techniques de traitement du signal innovantes, des heuristiques informatiques fines, des approches Machine Learning et Deep Learning (supervisé ou non). Travailler sur l'optimisation algorithmique en vue d'une implémentation embarquée, potentiellement en langage C, sur des systèmes aux ressources contraintes. Participer à la définition des critères de succès et des métriques pour le mesurer, et évaluer la performance des algorithmes sur des jeux de données variés. Ce stage offre une immersion complète dans le développement d'un produit de santé connecté de pointe, avec une application concrète et un impact direct sur la vie des utilisateurs. Vous rejoindrez une équipe multidisciplinaire et dynamique, où votre contribution sera essentielle pour transformer un prototype algorithmique en une fonctionnalité embarquée de nos dispositifs, conforme aux exigences de fiabilité et de performance de l'industrie médicale. Le sujet précis sera discuté avec le stagiaire au plus tard quelques semaines avant le stage. Requirements Connaissances théoriques en traitement du signal et en machine learning Compétences informatiques : programmation en Python, première expérience en framework deep learning (PyTorch ou TensorFlow) appréciée Bonus : programmation en C Intérêt pour le machine learning Intérêt pour les applications en santé connectée Lecture de l'anglais scientifique et technique Capacité rédactionnelle, de rigueur et d'autonomie Aptitude pour le travail en équipe et communication Durée : 4 à 6 mois Benefits Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est : Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues Assister à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médical Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites ! Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature. title: Platform Engineer
description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your Mission

At Catawiki, our Platform Horizontal has evolved from solely managing the cloud into a broad function supporting Reliability, Developer Experience, Security, and Quality. We take a holistic approach to creating systems and tools that help developers deliver applications seamlessly and reliably without getting bogged down in infrastructure complexity.
As a Platform Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security.

What You'll Do

You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale.

  • Build a self-service developer platform with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications.
  • Orchestrate cloud-native infrastructure, manage Kubernetes clusters and other cloud resources, focusing on performance, scalability, and cost efficiency through FinOps practices.
  • Boost developer productivity by building and enhancing CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and reusable templates that accelerate development and deployment cycles.
  • Drive reliability and scalability through applying practices for fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and scaling so applications run smoothly under changing conditions.
  • Improve platform operations usage and enhance our observability stack to monitor platform health and resolve incidents proactively.
  • Collaborate and innovate by partnering with product teams to understand their needs, build simple and impactful solutions, and champion cloud-native best practices across Catawiki.

What You'll Bring

You measure what matters, introduce changes gradually, and treat failure as a normal part of learning. You use tooling and automation wherever possible to reduce toil, and enjoy sharing knowledge with others.

  • Cloud-native expertise: At least 5 years of production experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Automation mindset: Experience automating workflows and CI/CD pipelines and working with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Observability experience: Hands-on experience using and maintaining tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry to improve reliability and performance.
  • Strong ownership: You proactively address platform issues and work toward long-term scalability and resilience.
  • Collaborative approach: You work effectively with developers and cross-functional teams to align goals and deliver impactful yet simple solutions.
  • Continuous learning: You keep developing your knowledge of cloud-native tools, technologies, and practices in a fast-moving ecosystem.

How We Work

The Platform Horizontal supports engineering teams across Catawiki by reducing infrastructure complexity and providing reliable, secure, and scalable foundations.

  • We collaborate closely with product teams to understand their challenges and improve their development experience.
  • We favour self-service capabilities, reusable solutions, automation, and measurable, gradual improvements.
  • We share knowledge and treat reliability, security, quality, and developer experience as shared responsibilities.

Where You'll Be

This is a Hybrid role based in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.
This role is open to candidates worldwide. For selected candidates, Catawiki can provide visa sponsorship and relocation support to the relevant location, subject to eligibility and applicable restrictions.

In Return

You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians.

  • A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.
  • A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.
  • Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.
  • Amazing Office right in the centre of Amsterdam.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team

title: Web Engineer Intern
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - EPIC GAMES SERVICES

What We Do

Driving the plug-in power behind Unreal Engine 5. We bridge connections for licensees and our own internal game teams to online services. This allows games like Fortnite to utilize a combination of platform online services as well as Epic’s own online services to build cross-platform online features. Login, parties, voice chat, matchmaking, purchasing, cloud storage, and analytics are just a few examples of online features that our Online Game Services team helps games utilize.

WEB ENGINEER INTERN

What You'll Do

We are looking for a Web Engineer Intern to join the Tools & Portals team within Epic Online Services. Tools & Portals builds the software, platforms, and digital experiences that enable Epic’s internal teams, player support operations, players, and external developers to work with and access Epic services more effectively. You will contribute to production systems across the full stack while gaining hands-on experience with modern web development, backend services, cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted software development.

In this role, you will

  • Build full-stack features using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with guidance from the team
  • Contribute to development of backend services and APIs using Next.js, NestJS, and Node.js
  • Learn and apply development practices for production infrastructure including AWS, Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Write, test, review, and deploy production code alongside experienced engineers
  • Learn and apply AI-assisted software development workflows throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Contribute to internal tools and developer-facing platforms used across Epic Games

What we're looking for

  • Interest in full-stack web development and learning modern engineering technologies
  • Some familiarity with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, or similar web technologies through coursework, projects, or previous experience
  • Eagerness to learn, ask questions, and contribute to solving well-defined engineering problems
  • Willingness to explore new technologies and codebases, seek support when needed, and incorporate feedback
  • Ability to work effectively with guidance, communicate questions and blockers, and incorporate feedback
  • Strong collaboration skills and willingness to work closely with engineers, product partners, external teams, and stakeholders
  • Understanding of defined requirements and willingness to ask clarifying questions when needed
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including sharing progress and incorporating feedback
  • Interest in using AI tools and AI-assisted workflows as part of software development

This internship has a flexible start date in 2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit epicgames.com/earlycareers. This is going to be Epic!

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here.

title: Post-doctorant.e en conception de catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels pour la conversion directe du CO2 en carburants liquides (H/F) – CDD 11 mois
description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. Le poste est ouvert dans le fond propre d’IMT Mines Albi. Une collaboration avec le laboratoire de chimie de coordination (LCC) à Toulouse est prévue. DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : A ce jour, les carburants fossiles sont encore largement utilisés dans les différents secteurs industriels et notamment pour le secteur de transport, qui sont une source importante d’émission de gaz à effet de serre. Pour réduire l’impact environnemental du secteur de transport, les carburants de synthèse jouent un rôle important, en particulier pour le transport aérien de demain. Parmi les voies de R&D étudiées à ce jour pour la production de ces carburants de synthèse, le captage du CO2 et l’hydrogénation directe de ce CO2 par de l’hydrogène obtenu par l’électrolyse de l’eau avec de l’électricité renouvelable est une voie stratégique. L'un de leurs atouts majeurs réside dans l’optimisation de la production pour minimiser le coût du produit final, et la compatibilité des carburants de synthèse avec les infrastructures et les flottes existantes. Ce projet, qui réunit deux laboratoires (RAPSODEE à Albi, et LCC à Toulouse), vise à produire des carburants alternatifs par hydrogénation directe du CO2 via une synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch à partir de CO2 (CO2-FTS). Ce processus se décompose en deux étapes successives : (i) l'hydrogénation du CO2 en CO (réaction inverse du gaz à l'eau, ou RWGS), suivie (ii) de l'hydrogénation du CO en hydrocarbures (synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch, ou FTS). Ce projet continue la recherche récente entre les deux laboratoires sur le même sujet, en développant des systèmes catalytiques multifonctionnels assurant la conversion, en une seule étape, dans un seul réacteur et à une seule condition de température et de pression, du CO2 et H2 en carburants liquides. Une attention particulière sera accordée à l’ingénierie de la composition, de la structure et de l’environnement des sites actifs, afin d’établir des relations structure-activité et de comprendre le rôle de chaque composant métallique dans les différentes étapes réactionnelles. Cette stratégie vise à dépasser les limitations des catalyseurs conventionnels en améliorant leur activité, sélectivité, stabilité et résistance à la désactivation. raw.description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs.

Le poste est ouvert dans le fond propre d’IMT Mines Albi. Une collaboration avec le laboratoire de chimie de coordination (LCC) à Toulouse est prévue.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

A ce jour, les carburants fossiles sont encore largement utilisés dans les différents secteurs industriels et notamment pour le secteur de transport, qui sont une source importante d’émission de gaz à effet de serre. Pour réduire l’impact environnemental du secteur de transport, les carburants de synthèse jouent un rôle important, en particulier pour le transport aérien de demain. Parmi les voies de R&D étudiées à ce jour pour la production de ces carburants de synthèse, le captage du CO2 et l’hydrogénation directe de ce CO2 par de l’hydrogène obtenu par l’électrolyse de l’eau avec de l’électricité renouvelable est une voie stratégique. L'un de leurs atouts majeurs réside dans l’optimisation de la production pour minimiser le coût du produit final, et la compatibilité des carburants de synthèse avec les infrastructures et les flottes existantes.

Ce projet, qui réunit deux laboratoires (RAPSODEE à Albi, et LCC à Toulouse), vise à produire des carburants alternatifs par hydrogénation directe du CO2 via une synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch à partir de CO2 (CO2-FTS). Ce processus se décompose en deux étapes successives : (i) l'hydrogénation du CO2 en CO (réaction inverse du gaz à l'eau, ou RWGS), suivie (ii) de l'hydrogénation du CO en hydrocarbures (synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch, ou FTS). Ce projet continue la recherche récente entre les deux laboratoires sur le même sujet, en développant des systèmes catalytiques multifonctionnels assurant la conversion, en une seule étape, dans un seul réacteur et à une seule condition de température et de pression, du CO2 et H2 en carburants liquides. Une attention particulière sera accordée à l’ingénierie de la composition, de la structure et de l’environnement des sites actifs, afin d’établir des relations structure-activité et de comprendre le rôle de chaque composant métallique dans les différentes étapes réactionnelles. Cette stratégie vise à dépasser les limitations des catalyseurs conventionnels en améliorant leur activité, sélectivité, stabilité et résistance à la désactivation. Le projet contribuera ainsi au développement d’une nouvelle génération de catalyseurs multifonctionnels pour la valorisation directe et durable du CO2 en carburants et produits chimiques à valeur ajoutée.

Les missions sont les suivantes :

  •        Etat de l’art : Une étude bibliographique est prévue sur les derniers travaux publiés sur ce sujet, pour compléter le travail réalisé en début de 2026.

  •        Synthèse et caractérisation des catalyseurs multifonctionnels : des catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels à base de fer et/ou de cobalt pour la conversion directe du CO2 en hydrocarbures par voie Fischer-Tropsch seront développés. L’objectif sera d’obtenir des matériaux présentant une synergie contrôlée entre différentes fonctions catalytiques, permettant de favoriser simultanément l’activation/hydrogénation du CO2, la formation des intermédiaires carbonés et leur transformation sélective en chaînes hydrocarbonées. Les paramètres à étudier sont : la modification des supports catalytiques par des promoteurs efficaces ; le contrôle de la taille, la forme et la composition de la phase active, le contrôle de l’équilibre entre les fonctions pour l’activation du CO2 et de l’hydrogène. Ces matériaux seront caractérisés par différentes méthodes de caractérisation conventionnelles ou avancées.

  •        Evaluation des systèmes catalytiques en CO2-FTS : Les catalyseurs synthétisés seront évalués à l’échelle laboratoire. La performance des meilleurs catalyseurs pourra être évaluée à l’échelle pilote.

  •        Valorisation des résultats : Les résultats obtenus feront l’objet de la valorisation sous forme de brevet et ensuite communiqués dans les congrès et les journaux scientifiques.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

Des compétences solides en catalyse hétérogène, en particulier pour la conversion du CO2 sont recherchées.

Capacités et aptitudes :

Des qualités de synthèse, d’organisation et de communication sont également nécessaires pour mener à bien les missions de ce poste.

Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse , vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites. Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance . Vos missions Votre rôle Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite . Vous êtes à la fois : un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ; un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ; un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents. Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre. Vos principales missions 1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels. Votre périmètre couvre notamment : les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ; les systèmes de secours électrique ; les UPS / onduleurs ; les groupes électrogènes ; les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ; les systèmes de refroidissement ; la protection et la sécurité incendie ; les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées. Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels . Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : structurer les processus d'exploitation ; définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ; rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ; mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ; contrôler leur bonne application ; identifier les écarts entre les sites ; proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ; partager les bonnes pratiques ; réaliser des REX multisites ; accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards. La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique. 4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations. Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à : analyser techniquement l'incident ; identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ; apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ; challenger les analyses proposées ; accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ; contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ; participer à la résolution de l'incident ; organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites. Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à : former et accompagner les équipes ; expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ; faire progresser les pratiques ; fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ; accompagner la conduite du changement ; favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites. Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes , et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial. Vous savez également analyser une problématique technique complexe, identifier les risques et challenger les solutions proposées. Response & automation

Telemetry & partnership

  • Define telemetry requirements for new systems before they ship, working with infrastructure and product teams to close visibility gaps rather than discovering them during an incident.
  • Threat hunt proactively across the estate, converting hypotheses into either new detections or documented coverage.

You Should Have

  • Typically 5–8 years of experience in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with real hands-on time writing and tuning detections. We care more about what you've built than the exact number.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or similar) and comfort writing production-grade detection and automation code.
  • Experience with a modern SIEM or detection pipeline (Panther, Elastic, Splunk, or similar). What matters is that you've shipped and tuned detection logic in production.
  • Practical incident response experience: you've led or played a major role in triaging and closing out real security incidents.

Nice to have

  • Experience defining telemetry contracts for systems before they ship, rather than retrofitting logging after an incident.

Für unseren Kunden aus der Energiebranche in Bern, suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n, motivierte:n und aufgeschlossene:n Softwaretester:in für Webapplikationen im Energiehandelskontext.

In diesem Projekt unterstützt du die Qualitätssicherung eines neu entwickelten Zeitreihenmanagementsystems, das eine bestehende Kernanwendung ablösen wird. Du stellst durch strukturierte Testaktivitäten sicher, dass die neue Lösung über den gesamten Projektverlauf hinweg stabil, zuverlässig und fachlich korrekt funktioniert und begleitest den Weg bis zum geplanten Go-Live.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Ableitung von Testfällen aus fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen sowie Planung und Durchführung von funktionalen Tests, Integrations-, Migrations- und Regressionstests
  • Prüfung der Webapplikation, ihrer APIs sowie systemübergreifender Prozesse und Datenflüsse über den Integrationslayer
  • Durchführung von End-to-End-Tests unter Berücksichtigung von Erfolgs- und Fehlerfällen sowie Überprüfung fachlicher Ergebnisse
  • Analyse, Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung von Defekten sowie Durchführung von Re-Tests nach Fehlerbehebungen
  • Enge Abstimmung mit Entwicklung, Fachbereich und Projektleitung zur Bewertung von Testergebnissen und Qualitätsrisiken
  • Unterstützung und Begleitung von Integrationstests sowie der Cut-over- und Go-Live-Phase
  • Sicherstellung einer nachvollziehbaren Testdokumentation und Unterstützung bei der fachlichen Abnahme der Lösung

Dein Profil:

  • Mehr als 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Software-Testing und in der Qualitätssicherung von Anwendungen
  • Erfahrung im Testen von Webapplikationen auf Basis von ASP.NET Blazor und C#
  • Praxis im Bereich API-Testing, idealerweise mit Postman, sowie Erfahrung mit Integrations- und Schnittstellentests
  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft und Verständnis für fachliche Prozesse, Zeitreihendaten und Datenflüsse von Vorteil
  • Analytische, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Klare und adressatengerechte Kommunikationsfähigkeit in Deutsch und Englisch

Zusätzlich von Vorteil:

  • Erfahrung in der Testautomatisierung für UI-, API- oder Regressionstests
  • Kenntnisse von PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB / TigerData sowie Zeitreihen-Datenbanken
  • Erfahrung in agilen Softwareentwicklungsprojekten und in der Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Projektteams

title: Sr. Software Engineer II / Tech lead, Agentic Platform (Poland, Remote, B2B)
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: We're building the next chapter: an agentic platform that understands operational context and takes action, with the ambition to make physical operations increasingly autonomous. External Platform EMEA owns critical capabilities behind that transition. Depending on the team, your work could include: Reporting and intelligence. Own the reporting engine and products that turn the complexity of a fleet into answers customers can act on. Enterprise administration. Build how customers configure and control Samsara at scale, from permissions and device metadata to AI-assisted onboarding. Developer and agent platform. Build APIs, event systems, integrations, and tools that give applications and AI agents access to operational data and actions. Business-critical infrastructure. A track record of turning partially defined customer or business challenges into technical direction, execution plans, and measurable outcomes with substantial autonomy. Strong system design judgment, including service boundaries, dependencies, failure modes, performance, and safe changes to production systems. Experience leading delivery through deep ownership of a critical system or coordination across multiple services and teams, balancing immediate needs with long-term architecture. Ability to improve other engineers’ effectiveness through mentoring, design reviews, and clear technical decisions. Extensive use of AI throughout engineering, including complex investigations and design exploration, with the ability to validate results and help teammates adopt effective workflows. An ideal candidate also has: Experience building customer-facing web and mobile workflow applications Contributed heavily to driving significant value to their customers Curiosity about our customers, and is eager to improve their day-to-day experience Seeks to iterate on new products based on customer feedback Exceptional problem-solving abilities and meticulous attention to detail.Strong communication skills for effective teamwork and project collaboration. Enthusiastic and committed to innovating in a fast-paced and dynamic team environment. Experience in any one of these areas is a plus. Exposure should come from enterprise-scale, production work. Reporting and data systems: Reporting products, analytics, query execution, data retrieval, or turning complex datasets into useful customer experiences. Enterprise administration: Permissions and access control, entity metadata, configuration frameworks, or customer onboarding and setup automation. Developer and agent platforms: Public APIs, event-driven systems, integrations, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or tools that let AI agents access data and take action. Billing and monetization: Billing systems, license assignment, product entitlements, or usage metering supporting how a business sells and delivers its products. Full-stack product development: Building complete customer experiences across frontend interfaces, backend services, and data models. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. Annual Base Salary 638 350 zł—751 000 zł PLN Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We're building the next chapter: an agentic platform that understands operational context and takes action, with the ambition to make physical operations increasingly autonomous. External Platform EMEA owns critical capabilities behind that transition. Depending on the team, your work could include:

  • Reporting and intelligence. Own the reporting engine and products that turn the complexity of a fleet into answers customers can act on.
  • Enterprise administration. Build how customers configure and control Samsara at scale, from permissions and device metadata to AI-assisted onboarding.
  • Developer and agent platform. Build APIs, event systems, integrations, and tools that give applications and AI agents access to operational data and actions.
  • Business-critical infrastructure. Own billing, license assignment, and usage metering: systems central to how Samsara sells, delivers, and grows its products.

The long-term opportunity is rooted in the physical world. Deployed hardware, data generated at the edge, and years of operational expertise form a foundation that's hard to replicate. As AI advances, it expands what we can build on that foundation. This is a place to develop deep engineering expertise while helping shape a platform with years of ambitious work ahead.

AI is also central to how we build. We expect engineers to push tools like Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor throughout design, implementation, testing, and production investigations, taking on more ambitious work while owning the quality of what they ship.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead technical discussions with teammates to identify gaps in our telematics data platform and influence roadmap by setting direction and recommending solutions
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams to make design decisions and understand downstream implications in our product to ensure a seamless customer experience
  • Ship features that deliver value to customers, consistently refining them based on gathered feedback.
  • Deliver full stack features across multiple tiers (front-end, back-end and mobile). GoLang, GraphQL, Typescript, React and ReactNative among other technologies. Direct experience with these technologies is not required.
  • Be responsible for maintaining the production systems that your team owns and provide operational support.
  • Make an impact on our core architecture, roadmap, and the wider engineering community.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of relevant engineering experience, including hands-on work building and operating complex enterprise systems.
  • A track record of turning partially defined customer or business challenges into technical direction, execution plans, and measurable outcomes with substantial autonomy.
  • Strong system design judgment, including service boundaries, dependencies, failure modes, performance, and safe changes to production systems.
  • Experience leading delivery through deep ownership of a critical system or coordination across multiple services and teams, balancing immediate needs with long-term architecture.
  • Ability to improve other engineers’ effectiveness through mentoring, design reviews, and clear technical decisions.
  • Extensive use of AI throughout engineering, including complex investigations and design exploration, with the ability to validate results and help teammates adopt effective workflows.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building customer-facing web and mobile workflow applications
  • Contributed heavily to driving significant value to their customers
  • Curiosity about our customers, and is eager to improve their day-to-day experience
  • Seeks to iterate on new products based on customer feedback
  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities and meticulous attention to detail.Strong communication skills for effective teamwork and project collaboration.
  • Enthusiastic and committed to innovating in a fast-paced and dynamic team environment.
  • Experience in any one of these areas is a plus. Exposure should come from enterprise-scale, production work.
    • Reporting and data systems: Reporting products, analytics, query execution, data retrieval, or turning complex datasets into useful customer experiences.
    • Enterprise administration: Permissions and access control, entity metadata, configuration frameworks, or customer onboarding and setup automation.
    • Developer and agent platforms: Public APIs, event-driven systems, integrations, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or tools that let AI agents access data and take action.
    • Billing and monetization: Billing systems, license assignment, product entitlements, or usage metering supporting how a business sells and delivers its products.
    • Full-stack product development: Building complete customer experiences across frontend interfaces, backend services, and data models.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

638 350 zł—751 000 zł PLN

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Ads Quality Rater - Dutch (Netherlands)
description: Overzicht Kom de toekomst van het internet vormgeven met je dagelijkse internetvaardigheden! Als Ads Quality Rater beoordeel en evalueer je internetadvertenties om ze beter en relevanter te maken voor eindgebruikers zoals jijzelf. Met andere woorden, je vertelt het systeem hoe goed of hoe slecht een advertentie is op basis van je begrip van de trefwoorden die bij elke advertentie verstrekt worden. Je beoordeelt advertenties zowel in het Engels als in het Nederlands. Deze functie is ideaal voor mensen die: · Dagelijks op het internet surfen · Vaak grote zoekmachines gebruiken · Advertenties herkennen wanneer ze verschijnen · Houden van online onderzoek doen over verschillende onderwerpen Daarnaast moeten alle Ads Quality Raters een geheimhoudingsovereenkomst ondertekenen en slagen voor een door de klant verstrekte test voordat ze worden aangenomen. Deze cruciale stappen garanderen geheimhouding van de klant en een hoog kwaliteitsniveau. Projectdetails Functieomschrijving: Ads Quality Rater Salaris: per taak (ca. $17 USD per uur) Locatie: op afstand, Nederland Uren: bepaal je eigen schema gebaseerd op het volgende: minimale inzet is 10 uur per week. Je kunt ervoor kiezen om tot 20 uur per week te werken (als het project dit toelaat). Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk Dienstverband: freelance; betaling elke 2 weken Projectduur: 12 maanden (met mogelijkheid tot verlenging) De hoeveelheid van data kan van week tot week variëren. Sommige weken is er meer data om te beoordelen, andere weken minder. Van alle Ads Quality Raters wordt verwacht dat zij minimaal 10 uur per week werken. Aanwervingsproces en stappen Welo Data streeft naar een inclusief en rechtvaardig wervingsproces. Alle kandidaten dienen de volgende stappen doorlopen om in aanmerking te komen voor dit project: • Sollicitatie kandidaat • Welo Data beoordeling sollicitatie • Kennis, evaluatie en kwalificatie kandidaat • Welo Data’s klant beoordeling • Definitieve goedkeuring Het wervingsproces kan tot 14 dagen in beslag nemen. Ervaring en vereisten Vloeiend in Nederlands (geschreven en gesproken) Conversationeel in Engels Betrouwbaar computersysteem en internetverbinding Bekend met het gebruik van online zoekmachines Kan instructies in het Engels ontvangen en begrijpen en kan voldoen aan de projectconventies en -regels die door de klant worden verwacht Bereid om een geheimhoudingsverklaring te tekenen ter bescherming van de klant Voldoet aan de leermodules en een vereiste kwaliteitstest ontworpen door onze klant voordat het werk begint Compensation Additional Information Overige informatie Preventie van fraude Projecten zoals deze zijn over de hele wereld grote doelwitten van fraude. Daarom voert Welo Data gedurende het hele proces fraudecontroles uit om ervoor te zorgen dat het programma wordt nageleefd. Alle accounts die frauduleus worden bevonden, worden onmiddellijk van het project verwijderd. Over Welo Data Welo Data is een wereldwijd data- en vertaalbedrijf met kantoren over de hele wereld. We hebben achter de schermen gewerkt aan een aantal van de grootste technische projecten ooit, van datalokalisatie en vertaling tot generatieve AI en deep learning. We zijn buitengewoon trots op onze klanten, onze medewerkers en de eindgebruikers van alle projecten waar we aan werken. Please note that this work is based on project needs. Due to this, weekly hours may vary and flexibility with change is expected. You must legally be able to work on freelance projects in the Netherlands . To know more details (Click here)

Who We Are Bayesian Health ’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. What you'll do As a Senior Software Engineer, Analytics, you will work closely with client success, product managers, clinicians, data scientists, and other software engineers to build infrastructure, frameworks, and tools to improve client analytics, facilitate clinical case reviews, and support product investigation. This role is crucial to provide internal visibility into product performance that will drive expansion of our clinical AI/ML module offerings and revenue growth. Responsibilities Product performance monitoring and optimization: Partner with client success and clinical product subject matter experts to implement the infrastructure, queries, and automation to monitor the KPIs and success metrics of our products across multiple clinical domains and clients. Clinical case review and investigation : Build frameworks and tools to empower our clinical team to independently review and investigate clinical cases reported by our clients and identify cases with certain criteria that need further evaluation. Data platform and analytics technical foundations: Propose and implement foundational improvements and innovations to boost our data platform scalability with expanding products and clients and uplevel our team analytics capabilities. Drive product analytics development cross-functionally: Work closely with Client Success, Clinical, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to drive alignment on product analytics at the company level. Minimum qualifications BS in Computer Science or other relevant technical discipline. 5+ years of experience in building scalable, secure analytics infrastructure and tools on a cloud platform (preferably AWS) to produce monitoring metrics and investigational data from complex data models and queries for live products and customers. Proficient in Python and SQL. Deep knowledge in modern data and analytics technologies, such as cloud-based data warehouses, transformation frameworks (e.g. dbt), workflow orchestration tools, and BI tools like Tableau or Quicksight, and keen ability to integrate with existing infrastructure to enhance capabilities. Experience working with sensitive data that contains PHI/PII. Excellent communication skills and a proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams (data science, product, clinical) to translate requirements into robust technical solutions Preferred qualifications Experience in leveraging LLMs in distributed data processing and analytics systems. Experience building analytics technology for clinical/health data. Experience handling ambiguity and uncertainty in a startup. title: Software Engineer, Application Integration
description: Software Engineer, Application Integration In Brief We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives. Who We Are Bayesian Health ’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. What you’ll do You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between the Bayesian platform and the clinical workflows inside massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, delivering the real-time lifesaving insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' EHR and clinical informatics teams, you'll bring our clinical insights to the point of care — in the right workflow, at the right moment — empowering care teams to make the best decisions for their patients. Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a clinician says the alert didn't fire for a patient, you have thirty minutes and their full attention to trace it from the EHR launch context through the API to the underlying data, and tell them what happened. Responsibilities Clinical Workflow Integration: Extend and configure the full-stack application across the EHR integration surface, coordinating with client EHR and clinical informatics teams, to deliver Bayesian's clinical insights to clinicians. Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests and work directly with client technical teams and frontline clinicians during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations. Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring all configurations and builds for the application and workflow are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any application integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication. raw.jobDescription:
Software Engineer, Application Integration

In Brief

  • We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.

  • Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives.

Who We Are

Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.

Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved.

What you’ll do

You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between the Bayesian platform and the clinical workflows inside massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, delivering the real-time lifesaving insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' EHR and clinical informatics teams, you'll bring our clinical insights to the point of care — in the right workflow, at the right moment — empowering care teams to make the best decisions for their patients.

Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a clinician says the alert didn't fire for a patient, you have thirty minutes and their full attention to trace it from the EHR launch context through the API to the underlying data, and tell them what happened.

Responsibilities

  • Clinical Workflow Integration: Extend and configure the full-stack application across the EHR integration surface, coordinating with client EHR and clinical informatics teams, to deliver Bayesian's clinical insights to clinicians.

  • Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests and work directly with client technical teams and frontline clinicians during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations.

  • Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring all configurations and builds for the application and workflow are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any application integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication.

  • Integration Tooling & Automation: Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the application integration workstream with the overall integration effort.

Minimum qualifications

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

  • 3+ years building and deploying full-stack applications into production, including integration with external APIs (React, TypeScript preferred)

  • Strong ability to investigate and resolve application issues end-to-end

  • Experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, etc.) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in a production environment

  • Experience writing automated integration and end-to-end tests for production systems

  • Strong communicator with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, working effectively with internal stakeholders, including Product Managers, to align on priorities and deliver results.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building EHR-embedded applications such as SMART on FHIR, CDS Hooks, or Epic launch integration.

  • Experience rolling out production deployments, supporting systems through go-live via an on-call or support rotation, and triaging production issues

  • Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require.

  • Experience building internal tooling or automation, including leveraging LLMs, to improve engineering velocity

title: Senior Software Developer, API Platform and Ecosystem
description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers , including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. What You’ll Do: Design, build, and operate MaintainX’s public-facing REST APIs, with a focus on consistency, scalability, and great developer experience. Want to see what it currently looks like? Head over here! Implement platform standards and patterns: authentication/authorization, rate limiting, versioning, filtering, pagination, idempotency, error semantics, and backwards compatibility. Design and implement robust batch and bulk API operations that enable high-volume data synchronization and large-scale migration workflows for enterprise customers. Decouple the REST API layer from monolithic dependencies while implementing strong contract testing to ensure GraphQL changes do not impact REST API stability, improving overall reliability and iteration speed. Build scaffolding, templates, and shared libraries that make connector/integration development faster and more consistent. Improve CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and quality gates for integrations and ecosystem services. Produce strong developer documentation and reference implementations (For eg. SDKs). Contribute to the infrastructure and workflows that allows integrations to be published, versioned, and supported in our internal or external integrations marketplace (Eg. Workato, Tray). Enable automation-driven onboarding flows (e.g., connection creation, credential management, environment configuration). Build standardized integration foundations and reusable building blocks for enterprise systems (e.g., SAP recipes and BTP building blocks; productized Oracle EBS/NetSuite and Microsoft D365 integrations). Ensure integrations meet enterprise expectations around security, auditability, performance, and operability. Own production services and platform components end-to-end: monitoring, on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis, and iterative hardening. Drive performance tuning and reliability improvements based on data (SLIs/SLOs, logs, traces, and metrics). About You: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend systems, APIs, or platform products (seniority flexible based on impact and scope). Strong experience with service-oriented backend development and one of the following languages (TypeScript, Go, C#) and willingness to learn other languages based on context. Strong experience working with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling. Solid foundation in distributed systems fundamentals: reliability, scalability, consistency, and failure modes. Experience shipping production-grade APIs and thinking deeply about developer experience and platform usability. Strong testing mindset (unit, integration, end to end and contract testing) and hands-on CI/CD experience. Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Design, and customer-facing teams, while keeping work centered on scalable product solutions (not one-off implementations). raw.jobDescription:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and operate MaintainX’s public-facing REST APIs, with a focus on consistency, scalability, and great developer experience. Want to see what it currently looks like? Head over here!

  • Implement platform standards and patterns: authentication/authorization, rate limiting, versioning, filtering, pagination, idempotency, error semantics, and backwards compatibility.

  • Design and implement robust batch and bulk API operations that enable high-volume data synchronization and large-scale migration workflows for enterprise customers.

  • Decouple the REST API layer from monolithic dependencies while implementing strong contract testing to ensure GraphQL changes do not impact REST API stability, improving overall reliability and iteration speed.

  • Build scaffolding, templates, and shared libraries that make connector/integration development faster and more consistent.

  • Improve CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and quality gates for integrations and ecosystem services.

  • Produce strong developer documentation and reference implementations (For eg. SDKs).

  • Contribute to the infrastructure and workflows that allows integrations to be published, versioned, and supported in our internal or external integrations marketplace (Eg. Workato, Tray).

  • Enable automation-driven onboarding flows (e.g., connection creation, credential management, environment configuration).

  • Build standardized integration foundations and reusable building blocks for enterprise systems (e.g., SAP recipes and BTP building blocks; productized Oracle EBS/NetSuite and Microsoft D365 integrations).

  • Ensure integrations meet enterprise expectations around security, auditability, performance, and operability.

  • Own production services and platform components end-to-end: monitoring, on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis, and iterative hardening.

  • Drive performance tuning and reliability improvements based on data (SLIs/SLOs, logs, traces, and metrics).

About You:

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend systems, APIs, or platform products (seniority flexible based on impact and scope).

  • Strong experience with service-oriented backend development and one of the following languages (TypeScript, Go, C#) and willingness to learn other languages based on context.

  • Strong experience working with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.

  • Solid foundation in distributed systems fundamentals: reliability, scalability, consistency, and failure modes.

  • Experience shipping production-grade APIs and thinking deeply about developer experience and platform usability.

  • Strong testing mindset (unit, integration, end to end and contract testing) and hands-on CI/CD experience.

  • Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Design, and customer-facing teams, while keeping work centered on scalable product solutions (not one-off implementations).

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with integration ecosystems: API platforms, SDKs, iPaaS/connectors, marketplaces, webhooks/events, ETL/sync patterns.

  • Familiarity with enterprise identity/security patterns (OAuth2/OIDC, API keys, token rotation, least privilege).

  • Experience with ERP ecosystems (SAP S/4HANA or ECC 6, SAP BTP, Oracle EBS/NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics).

  • Experience building self-serve admin/debug tooling for external developers/customers.

  • Experience with Workato, Tray, or Zapier from a product/platform engineering perspective (e.g., building connectors, not just recipes, workflows, or zaps—though familiarity with those is valuable too).

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.
